151	  - Its Utilities Maintenance has 13 items. Two are absent from the install seed: "Re-calculate brought forward amounts in GL" (`/Z_UpdateChartDetailsBFwd.php`) and "Re-Post all GL transactions from a specified period" (`/Z_RePostGLFromPeriod.php`).
152	  - The install seed has Utilities Maintenance sequences 9, 12 and 13 but not 10 and 11.
153	  - GL Maintenance in the upgrade has 12 items, GL Reports 18 and stock Reports 21. The install seed is a later snapshot with more rows. Later updates such as `webERP/sql/updates/15.php` and `16.php` alter the menu further (behaviour of those not read here).
154	- **`webERP/includes/MainMenuLinksArray.php`** reads the tables at login.
155	  - It unsets `$_SESSION['ModuleLink']`, `ReportList`, `ModuleList` and `MenuItems`.
156	  - It selects from `modules` where `secroleid = $_SESSION['AccessLevel']`, ordered by `sequence`.
157	  - It selects from `menuitems` where `secroleid = $_SESSION['AccessLevel']`, ordered by `sequence`, then `menusection`.
158	  - It stores the `modulelink` as `$ModuleLink[]`, the `reportlink` as `$ReportList[modulelink]`, and `__(modulename)` as `$ModuleList[]`.
159	  - It stores `__(caption)` and `url` under `$MenuItems[modulelink][menusection]['Caption'|'URL'][]`.
160	  - It has no error handler and no check on `AccessLevel`.
161	- **`webERP/sql/demo.sql`** also contains `menuitems` (its content was not read).
162	- **`webERP/includes/UpgradeDB_*.php`** (mysql, mysqli, mariadb, postgres) also mention `menuitems` (content not read).
163	
164	## Conclusions
165	- The menu is selected by `secroleid` equal to the user's `AccessLevel`. A user whose access level has no rows in `menuitems` or `modules` gets an empty menu. The seeds give rows for ids 1–9 only, so any other id gets no module or menu rows. A user who is not in 1–9 sees nothing.
166	- The `modules` seed covers ids 1–9, all with the same 11 modules. There is no per-role restriction in the data, so restriction can only come from `menuitems` rows being absent for a role.
167	- The `menuitems` primary key includes `caption`, so one caption cannot repeat within a role, module and section. This is why "Select Supplier" appears in both AP Maintenance and AP Transactions.
168	- The install seed and the upgrade script `5.php` insert the same menu rows by different routes. A new install and an upgraded database can therefore differ. For example, only the upgrade adds the two `/Z_UpdateChartDetailsBFwd.php` and `/Z_RePostGLFromPeriod.php` items.
169	- `PO_SelectOSPurchOrder.php` is registered under stock Transactions as "Receive Purchase Orders" and under PO Transactions as "Purchase Orders". `/SelectSalesOrder.php` and `/SelectSupplier.php` also appear in two sections each.
170	- Running the inserts twice fails on the primary key, so the seed is not repeatable without clearing the tables first.
171	- `systypes` ids 500 and 600 are the auto-number counters for debtors and suppliers.
172	
173	## Hazards
174	- Paths are not checked against real scripts, and the url column is varchar(60). The `&` encoding is stored literally.
175	- The install seed and the upgrade scripts keep separate copies of the menu list. A change to one does not reach the other.

# webERP install seed data: menu items, module list and transaction types

Part of [webERP installer, seed data, schema, build/CI and project-history area](weberp-installer-seed-data-schema-build-ci-and-project-histo-150/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

The topic holds three SQL seed files for the install database: `menuitems` rows, `modules` rows and `systypes` rows. Nothing runs inside the files. The installer loads them, and the application reads `menuitems` and `modules` to build the main menu.

## Contract
- **Takes in:** literal SQL `INSERT` statements only. Nothing is validated or converted.
- **Writes to:** three tables.
  - `menuitems` (schema in `webERP/install/sql/tables/menuitems.sql`):
    - Columns: `secroleid` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 8, `modulelink` varchar(10), `menusection` varchar(15), `caption` varchar(60), `url` varchar(60), `sequence` int DEFAULT 1.
    - Primary key: (`secroleid`, `modulelink`, `menusection`, `caption`).
    - No index on `url` or `sequence`, and no foreign key on `secroleid`.
  - `modules`: tuples (role/company id, `modulelink`, `reportlink` dir, `modulename`, `sequence`).
  - `systypes`: (`typeid`, `typename`, and one numeric field that is 0 in every row).
- **`menuitems` row shape:** (`secroleid`, module, section, caption, url, sequence).
  - Modules: `Sales`, `AR`, `PO`, `AP`, `stock`, `manuf`, `GL`, `FA`, `PC`, `system`, `Utilities`.
  - Sections: `Maintenance`, `Reports`, `Transactions`.
  - Fixture variants: one rendering of the file shows `secroleid` 1 and others show 2–9 for different blocks. Several blocks carry a role id 2–9 or "version 2 or 3". The first column is the role id, and the rows are repeated per role id 1–9.
  - Query strings keep the `&` encoding, for example `/CustomerReceipt.php?NewReceipt=Yes&Type=GL`.
  - `ProdSpecGroups.php` ("Product Spec Groups Maintenance", `manuf` Maintenance, sequence 9) appears for role ids 1–9.
- **`modules` seed:** 11 modules for each of 9 role ids (99 rows), in the same order for every id. The values are (module, dir, sequence):

| Module | Dir | Sequence |
|---|---|---|
| Sales | ord | 1 |
| AR | ar | 2 |
| PO | prch | 3 |
| AP | ap | 4 |
| stock | inv | 5 |
| manuf | man | 6 |
| GL | gl | 7 |
| FA | fa | 8 |
| PC | pc | 9 |
| system | sys | 10 |
| Utilities | util | 11 |

- **`systypes` seed:**
  - Journal - GL 0, Payment - GL 1, Receipt - GL 2, Standing Journal 3, Journal Template Number 4.
  - Sales Invoice 10, Credit Note 11, Receipt 12, Journal - Debtors 15, Location Transfer 16, Stock Adjustment 17, Purchase Order 18, Picking List 19.
  - Purchase Invoice 20, Debit Note 21, Creditors Payment 22, Creditors Journal 23, Purchase Order Delivery 25.
  - Work Order Receipt 26, Work Order Issue 28, Work Order Variance 29, Sales Order 30, Shipment Close 31, Contract Close 32.
  - Cost Update 35, Exchange Difference 36, Tenders 37, Stock Requests 38, Sales Commision Accruals 39 (spelled so in the data).
  - Work Order 40, Asset Addition 41, Asset Category Change 42, Delete w/down asset 43, Depreciation 44.
  - Import Fixed Assets 49, Opening Balance 50, Auto Debtor Number 500, Auto Supplier Number 600.

## Entry points
None. These are data files with no handlers or guards. There is no check that a path exists, no deduplication, and no per-user condition. The only guard is the `menuitems` primary key, which rejects a repeated (`secroleid`, `modulelink`, `menusection`, `caption`).

## Decisions
There are no branches. The data is declarative.

### Menu content by module, section and count
Entries come from the fixtures. Where the fixtures differ, the larger list is given.

- **AP**
  - Maintenance: Add Supplier `/Suppliers.php` 1, Select Supplier `/SelectSupplier.php` 2, Maintain Factor Companies `/Factors.php` 3.
  - Reports (8): `/AgedSuppliers.php`, `/PDFSuppTransListing.php`, `/OutstandingGRNs.php`, `/SuppPaymentRun.php`, `/PDFRemittanceAdvice.php`, `/SupplierBalsAtPeriodEnd.php`, `/SupplierTransInquiry.php`, `/SuppWhereAlloc.php`.
  - Transactions: `/SelectSupplier.php` 1, `/SupplierAllocations.php` 2.
- **AR**
  - Maintenance: `/Customers.php` 1, `/SelectCustomer.php` 2.
  - Reports (10): `/AgedDebtors.php`, `/CustomerBalancesMovement.php`, `/PDFCustomerList.php`, `/CustomerTransInquiry.php`, `/DebtorsAtPeriodEnd.php`, `/PDFCustTransListing.php`, `/PrintCustTrans.php`, `/PrintCustStatements.php`, `/PDFBankingSummary.php`, `/CustWhereAlloc.php`.
  - Transactions (4):
    - `/SelectSalesOrder.php` 1
    - `/SelectCreditItems.php?NewCredit=Yes` 2
    - `/CustomerReceipt.php?NewReceipt=Yes&Type=Customer` 3
    - `/CustomerAllocations.php` 4
- **FA**

- **Sales**

  - Transactions (15):
    - Z_ChangeCustomerCode 1, Z_ChangeBranchCode 2, Z_ChangeGLAccountCode 3, Z_ChangeStockCode 4, Z_ChangeLocationCode 5, Z_ChangeSalesmanCode 6.

    - Z_ReApplyCostToSA 11, Z_DeleteSalesTransActions 12, Z_ReverseSuppPaymentRun 13.
    - Z_UpdateSalesAnalysisWithLatestCustomerData 14, Z_GLAccountUsersCopyAuthority 15.

## Order and failure
- Rows are plain inserts. A duplicate primary key makes the statement fail, and the files have no handler.
- Nothing is committed in a defined order across the files.

## Connections
- **`webERP/sql/updates/5.php`** (database migration for version 2.9) is a second writer of the same rows.
  - It creates `modules` (`secroleid`, `modulelink` primary key, `modulename`, `sequence`) and `menuitems`.
  - It then calls `NewModule()` for the 11 modules with sequences 1–11, and `NewMenuItem(module, section, label, path, order)` about 107+ times, followed by the system and Utilities items.
  - It ends with `UpdateDBNo(basename(__FILE__, '.php'), __('Move the menu and module strings to the database'))`, called only if `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0`.
  - Its Utilities Maintenance has 13 items. Two are absent from the install seed: "Re-calculate brought forward amounts in GL" (`/Z_UpdateChartDetailsBFwd.php`) and "Re-Post all GL transactions from a specified period" (`/Z_RePostGLFromPeriod.php`).
  - The install seed has Utilities Maintenance sequences 9, 12 and 13 but not 10 and 11.
  - GL Maintenance in the upgrade has 12 items, GL Reports 18 and stock Reports 21. The install seed is a later snapshot with more rows. Later updates such as `webERP/sql/updates/15.php` and `16.php` alter the menu further (behaviour of those not read here).
- **`webERP/includes/MainMenuLinksArray.php`** reads the tables at login.
  - It unsets `$_SESSION['ModuleLink']`, `ReportList`, `ModuleList` and `MenuItems`.
  - It selects from `modules` where `secroleid = $_SESSION['AccessLevel']`, ordered by `sequence`.
  - It selects from `menuitems` where `secroleid = $_SESSION['AccessLevel']`, ordered by `sequence`, then `menusection`.
  - It stores the `modulelink` as `$ModuleLink[]`, the `reportlink` as `$ReportList[modulelink]`, and `__(modulename)` as `$ModuleList[]`.
  - It stores `__(caption)` and `url` under `$MenuItems[modulelink][menusection]['Caption'|'URL'][]`.
  - It has no error handler and no check on `AccessLevel`.
- **`webERP/sql/demo.sql`** also contains `menuitems` (its content was not read).
- **`webERP/includes/UpgradeDB_*.php`** (mysql, mysqli, mariadb, postgres) also mention `menuitems` (content not read).

## Conclusions
- The menu is selected by `secroleid` equal to the user's `AccessLevel`. A user whose access level has no rows in `menuitems` or `modules` gets an empty menu. The seeds give rows for ids 1–9 only, so any other id gets no module or menu rows. A user who is not in 1–9 sees nothing.
- The `modules` seed covers ids 1–9, all with the same 11 modules. There is no per-role restriction in the data, so restriction can only come from `menuitems` rows being absent for a role.
- The `menuitems` primary key includes `caption`, so one caption cannot repeat within a role, module and section. This is why "Select Supplier" appears in both AP Maintenance and AP Transactions.
- The install seed and the upgrade script `5.php` insert the same menu rows by different routes. A new install and an upgraded database can therefore differ. For example, only the upgrade adds the two `/Z_UpdateChartDetailsBFwd.php` and `/Z_RePostGLFromPeriod.php` items.
- `PO_SelectOSPurchOrder.php` is registered under stock Transactions as "Receive Purchase Orders" and under PO Transactions as "Purchase Orders". `/SelectSalesOrder.php` and `/SelectSupplier.php` also appear in two sections each.
- Running the inserts twice fails on the primary key, so the seed is not repeatable without clearing the tables first.
- `systypes` ids 500 and 600 are the auto-number counters for debtors and suppliers.

## Hazards
- Paths are not checked against real scripts, and the url column is varchar(60). The `&` encoding is stored literally.
- The install seed and the upgrade scripts keep separate copies of the menu list. A change to one does not reach the other.

1	# webERP includes: user-defined sales report SQL builder, form-field helpers, and per-database upgrade helper libraries
2	
3	Part of [webERP database installation and upgrade](weberp-database-installation-and-upgrade-149/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.
4	
5	The topic holds three kinds of PHP include. The first is the SQL builder for user-defined sales analysis reports. The second is HTML form-field helpers. The third is the schema-upgrade helper libraries, one per database driver: mariadb, mysql, mysqli and postgres. The report SQL builder takes `ReportID` from its includer, reads `reportheaders`, `reportcolumns` and `salesanalysis`, and leaves the SQL fragments for the includer's PDF or CSV generator. The upgrade libraries are included by the upgrade and install scripts and run idempotent DDL and DML through `executeSQL`, `DB_query` and `OutputResult`.

7	## Contract
8	
9	### ConstructSQLForUserDefinedSalesReport.php
10	
11	**Input**
12	- It reads `$_GET['ReportID']` directly, with no sanitising, and concatenates it into two queries (`GetReportSpecSQL`, `GetColsSQL`).
13	- `GetReportSpecSQL` reads `reportheaders`. `GetColsSQL` reads `reportcolumns`.
14	- Data comes from `salesanalysis` joined to lookup tables: areas, stockmaster, debtorsmaster, salestypes, stockcategory, custbranch, salesman.
15	- `$ReportSpec` holds `groupbydata1..4` and the bounds `lower1..4` and `upper1..4`.

21	- Data columns are aliased `col(colno+8)`.

25	  - Needs `$PageSecurity` in `$_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']`.

122	### UpgradeDB_* (all functions are unguarded)
123	
124	These are the checks shared across the mysql, mysqli, mariadb and postgres variants, with differences noted.
125	
126	**Existence checks**
127	- `NewSecurityToken` inserts only if no row exists with that `tokenid`.
128	- `NewSysType` inserts only if no row exists with that `typeid`.
129	- `NewScript` inserts only if no row exists with that `script`.
130	- `RemoveScript` deletes only if the script row exists.
131	- `NewModule` runs only if no `modulelink` row exists. For each `secroleid` in `securityroles` it runs `UPDATE modules SET sequence=sequence+1 WHERE sequence>=$Sequence AND secroleid=…`, then INSERTs.
132	- `NewMenuItem` runs only if no row matches `modulelink`, `menusection` and `url`. For each role it bumps the sequence (scoped by `modulelink` and `menusection`) and then INSERTs.
133	  - The mysql variant's UPDATE uses `link=$Link AND section=$Section`. These are not the names of the `menuitems` columns (`modulelink` and `menusection`), which the other three variants use.
134	- `RemoveMenuItem` deletes only if a row exists. In mariadb, mysql and mysqli, a loop over `securityroles` issues the same DELETE once per role. The DELETE is not filtered by `secroleid`.
135	- `UpdateMenuCaption` runs an unconditional UPDATE of caption from old to new.
136	- `CreateTrigger` creates the trigger only if `information_schema.triggers` has no row for that name and schema.
137	
138	**Existence checks for tables and columns**
139	- `AddColumn` runs only if `DB_table_exists`. It then adds the column if `isset($SQLFile)` or the column does not exist.
140	  - `DEFAULT` is added only if `$Type!='text'` and `$Default!=''`. `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` is left unquoted.
141	- `AddCalculatedColumn` follows the same existence rule.
142	  - mariadb adds `PERSISTENT`.
143	  - mysqli adds `STORED`.
144	- `AddIndex` runs only if the table exists and the index is absent.
145	- `DropIndex` runs if the index exists.
146	- `DropColumn` runs if `isset($SQLFile)` or `DB_num_rows != 0`.
147	- `ChangeColumnSize` runs if `CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH <> $Size`.
148	- `ChangeColumnName` runs if the old column exists and the new one does not.

157	- `NewConfigValue` inserts if no `confname` row exists.
158	- `ChangeConfigValue` updates if no row exists with that `confname` AND `confvalue=new`.
159	- `ChangeConfigName` updates if no row has `confname=$NewConfName`.
160	- `DeleteConfigValue` deletes only when `DB_num_rows(SELECT confname=$ConfName) == 0`. That runs the DELETE when the name does not exist and prints "already removed" when it does exist. The condition is inverted.
161	
162	**Tables and constraints**
163	- `CreateTable($Table,$SQL,$CharacterSet='utf8mb4')` runs only when `SHOW TABLES` returns 0 rows.
164	  - It wraps the CREATE in `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys` and `DB_ReinstateForeignKeys` and appends `ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=$CharacterSet`.
165	  - The postgres file's variant takes only `$Table` and `$SQL`, with the charset fixed to `utf8`.
166	- `ConstraintExists` reads `information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS`.
167	- `DropConstraint` runs `DROP FOREIGN KEY` if the constraint exists.
168	- `AddConstraint` runs if the constraint does not exist. Array `$Field` and `$ReferenceField` values are imploded with ','.
169	- `UpdateField` runs only if `DB_table_exists`. It then updates only if the current value differs from `$NewValue`.
170	  - If the column check fails and `isset($SQLFile)`, it runs the UPDATE unchecked.
171	- `DeleteRecords` deletes if `SELECT … WHERE $Criteria` returns more than 0 rows.
172	- `DropTable` runs if `SHOW TABLES` returns more than 0 rows.
173	- `InsertRecord` checks `CheckFields=CheckValues`. It inserts if no row matches or `isset($SQLFile)`. Values go through `DB_escape_string`.
174	- `DropPrimaryKey` drops only if the current key columns equal `$OldKey` and the count matches.
175	- `AddPrimaryKey` adds the key if the count of existing key columns `!= sizeOf($Fields)`.
176	- `RenameTable`:
177	  - If both the new and old tables exist, it drops the old table.
178	  - If the new table does not exist, it runs RENAME.
179	  - Otherwise it reports info.
180	- `SetAutoIncStart`:
181	  - If `MAX(field) > $StartNumber`, it reports a warning and does not alter.
182	  - Otherwise it runs `ALTER TABLE … AUTO_INCREMENT=$StartNumber`.
183	- `CharacterSet($Table)` returns `TABLE_COLLATION`.
184	
185	**Postgres file**
186	- It holds `CharacterSet`, `CreateTrigger`, the `New*`/`Remove*` helpers, `AddColumn` and `AddIndex`.
187	- It also holds a MySQL-style set that covers the index, column, config, `CreateTable` and constraint functions listed above.
188	- It also holds `SetAutoIncStart` and `OutputResult`.
189	- Despite the name, it uses MySQL syntax: backticks, `SHOW INDEX`, `SHOW TABLES`, `information_schema`, `DROP FOREIGN KEY`.
190	
191	## Order and failure
192	
193	- Each helper checks state first and then makes one `executeSQL($SQL,false)` call.
194	  - A response of 0 gives `OutputResult(...,'success')`.
195	  - Any other response gives `OutputResult(...,'error')` with the SQL, in most variants.
196	  - There is no retry, no transaction and no rollback.
197	- `executeSQL($SQL)` without the second argument is used in `DropPrimaryKey`, `AddPrimaryKey` and `DropTable`. What that argument does is not shown (behaviour not in this topic).
198	- `NewModule`, `NewMenuItem` and `RemoveMenuItem` loop over `securityroles`.
199	  - Roles already processed stay changed if a later role fails.
200	  - The result is reported as success or error, per iteration or for the last one.
201	- `DB_query` and `executeSQL` failures are not handled in the report builder or `UIGeneralFunctions`. They pass to the caller.
202	- Report builder: an invalid `ReportID` gives null results. Reading `$ReportSpec` and `$Cols` keys without checking will raise warnings or errors.
203	
204	## Connections
205	
206	- **Tables read or written:**
207	  - Report builder reads `reportheaders`, `reportcolumns`, `salesanalysis` and the lookup tables.
208	  - `UIGeneralFunctions` reads `currencies`, `companies`, `debtortype`, `chartmaster`, `accountgroups`, `glaccountusers`.
209	  - Upgrade helpers write `securitytokens`, `systypes`, `scripts`, `modules`, `menuitems` and `config`, and read `securityroles`.
210	  - Upgrade helpers also read `information_schema` for tables, columns, triggers, key usage and constraints.
211	- **Builder to its includers:** it hands back SQL fragments and column counts. The PDF and CSV generators and `report_runner.php` use them.
212	- **Other callees (behaviour not in this topic):** `DB_query`, `DB_num_rows`, `DB_fetch_array`, `DB_fetch_row`, `DB_table_exists`, `DB_escape_string`, `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys`, `DB_ReinstateForeignKeys`, `executeSQL`, `prnMsg`, `FormatDateForSQL`.
213	- **Upgrade file selection:** `$DBType` picks the file in `Z_UpgradeDatabase.php` and `install/pages/page_6.php`. Only one is loaded per run.
214	- **Report editors:** the builder links to `SalesAnalReptCols.php` and to `index.php`.
215	
216	## Conclusions
217	
218	- **Report builder scope.** Despite its name, it is shared by four live paths: the interactive page, the PDF email, the CSV email and the CLI runner.
219	  - Only `SalesAnalysis_UserDefined.php` checks `AllowedPageSecurityTokens`.
220	  - The two mail scripts and `bin/report_runner.php` are not shown to do such a check, so they take a `ReportID` from the caller without a permission check.
221	  - The runner still needs `session.php`.
222	- **Four-column limit.** The report is limited to 10 output columns.
223	  - It supports 4 grouping levels, and each deeper level only applies if the shallower one is used.
224	  - If level 2 is 'Not Used', levels 3 and 4 are dropped even if they are set.
225	- **`calculation` values other than 0.** Only `calculation==0` is shown. Other values are not shown, so reports using them are not described here.
226	- **Same-input behaviour.**
227	  - The upgrade helpers are mostly idempotent. A second run reports 'info', which the session counts as a warning because `OutputResult` counts anything other than 'error' or 'success' as a warning.
228	  - `UpdateMenuCaption` is idempotent in effect.
229	  - `ChangeConfigName` and `DeleteConfigValue` are not idempotent.
230	  - `RemoveMenuItem` runs the same DELETE once per role.
231	- **`NewModule` and `NewMenuItem` duplicate check.** They check existence of one row for `modulelink` (plus `menusection` and `url` for menu items) across all roles. A partial earlier run that created rows for only some roles blocks a repeat run, and the remaining roles never get the entry.
232	- **Variant differences.** Where several upgrade files do the same job, the differences are:
233	  - mariadb and mysqli use `PERSISTENT` or `STORED`.
234	  - The postgres file's `CreateTable` has no `$CharacterSet` parameter.
235	  - The mysql variant of `NewMenuItem` uses column names `link` and `section` in its UPDATE.
236	  - A fix to one file does not reach the others.
237	- **Condition problems the condensations flag.**
238	  - `DropColumn` and `ChangeColumnName`/`ChangeColumnType` logic is called inverted or unsafe in the mysql and postgres files.
239	  - `DeleteConfigValue` is called inverted.
240	  - `ChangeConfigValue` tests the value with `confvalue=$NewConfigValue`.
241	- **SQL injection.** It exists throughout. Names and values are concatenated into SQL, except `InsertRecord` values, which use `DB_escape_string`.
242	- **GL account filter.** `FieldToSelectOneGLAccount` lists only accounts the user has a `glaccountusers` row for. An unknown `$Filter` value gives no extra condition, so the list is not narrowed by P&L, balance sheet or permission.
243	
244	## Hazards
245	
246	- `$_GET['ReportID']` goes unescaped into SQL, so injection is possible via `SalesAnalysis_UserDefined.php`.
247	- Bounds (`lower1..4`, `upper1..4`) and column fields go unescaped into the WHERE and SELECT clauses.
248	- There is no transaction around the per-role loops, so partial application is possible.
249	- The inverted `DeleteConfigValue` condition can delete nothing, or run DELETE when the name is absent.
250	- `NewModule` and `NewMenuItem` can leave roles half-populated, and a repeat run then skips them.
251	- `RemoveMenuItem` repeats the same DELETE for every role.
252	- The `OutputResult` counters live in the session, so the 'error' messages are kept but other messages are not.
253

# webERP includes: user-defined sales report SQL builder, form-field helpers, and per-database upgrade helper libraries

Part of [webERP database installation and upgrade](weberp-database-installation-and-upgrade-149/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

The topic holds three kinds of PHP include. The first is the SQL builder for user-defined sales analysis reports. The second is HTML form-field helpers. The third is the schema-upgrade helper libraries, one per database driver: mariadb, mysql, mysqli and postgres. The report SQL builder takes `ReportID` from its includer, reads `reportheaders`, `reportcolumns` and `salesanalysis`, and leaves the SQL fragments for the includer's PDF or CSV generator. The upgrade libraries are included by the upgrade and install scripts and run idempotent DDL and DML through `executeSQL`, `DB_query` and `OutputResult`.

## Contract

### ConstructSQLForUserDefinedSalesReport.php

**Input**
- It reads `$_GET['ReportID']` directly, with no sanitising, and concatenates it into two queries (`GetReportSpecSQL`, `GetColsSQL`).
- `GetReportSpecSQL` reads `reportheaders`. `GetColsSQL` reads `reportcolumns`.
- Data comes from `salesanalysis` joined to lookup tables: areas, stockmaster, debtorsmaster, salestypes, stockcategory, custbranch, salesman.
- `$ReportSpec` holds `groupbydata1..4` and the bounds `lower1..4` and `upper1..4`.
- Each `$Cols` row holds `colno`, `periodfrom`, `periodto`, `budgetoractual`, `calculation` and `datatype`.

**Output**
- It builds `$SQLSelectCls`, `$SQLWhereCls` and `$SQLGroupCls`.
- Group levels use column pairs: `col1`/`col2`, `col3`/`col4`, `col5`/`col6`, `col7`/`col8`.
- Data columns are aliased `col(colno+8)`.

**Includers (live)**
- `webERP/SalesAnalysis_UserDefined.php`
  - Needs `$PageSecurity` in `$_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']`.
  - `ProducePDF` includes `PDFSalesAnalysis.php`. `ProduceCVSFile` includes `CSVSalesAnalysis.php`.
  - If `$Counter` is 0 on the PDF path, it shows an error.
  - It does not validate `ReportID`.
- `webERP/MailSalesReport.php`
  - Includes the builder and `PDFSalesAnalysis.php`.
  - Gets recipients from `GetMailList('SalesAnalysisReportRecipients')`.
  - Writes the PDF to `$_SESSION['reports_dir']/SalesAnalysis_<date>.pdf` and sends it with `SendEmailFromWebERP`.
- `webERP/MailSalesReport_csv.php`
  - Includes the builder and `includes/CSVSalesAnalysis.php`.
  - Emails `$_SESSION['reports_dir']/SalesAnalysis.csv` with subject 'Sales Analysis - CSV Format'.
- `webERP/bin/report_runner.php`
  - Includes the builder and `PDFSalesAnalysis.php`.
  - Writes the report file and sends it with `SendEmailFromWebERP`.
  - It needs `session.php`.

### UIGeneralFunctions.php

- Its functions return or echo HTML fields.
- They read the tables `currencies` (joined to `companies` with `coycode='1'`), `debtortype`, `chartmaster`, `accountgroups` and `glaccountusers`.
- Includers seen: `webERP/AuditScripts.php` and `webERP/CompanyPreferences.php`.

### UpgradeDB_* libraries

**Includers**
- `webERP/Z_UpgradeDatabase.php` line 59: `include('includes/UpgradeDB_' . $DBType . '.php')`.
- `webERP/install/pages/page_6.php` line 48 includes the same file.
- `$DBType` chooses the file. The drivers are mariadb, mysql, mysqli and postgres.
- The Z_Upgrade_* scripts and `UpgradeDatabase.php` are the likely callers (not read).

**Writes**
- Tables: `securitytokens(tokenid, tokenname)`, `systypes(typeid, typename)`, `scripts(script, pagesecurity, description)`, `modules(secroleid, modulelink, reportlink, modulename, sequence)`, `menuitems(secroleid, modulelink, menusection, caption, url, sequence)` and `config(confname, confvalue)`.
- Schema statements: ALTER, CREATE and DROP statements, using `$_SESSION['DatabaseName']` for information_schema lookups.
- Session counters:
  - `OutputResult($Msg, $Status)` with `$Status=='error'` increments `$_SESSION['Updates']['Errors']` and appends `$Msg` to `$_SESSION['Updates']['Messages']`.
  - `$Status=='success'` increments `Successes`.
  - Any other status, including 'info' and 'warn', increments `Warnings`.

## Entry points and guards

### Report SQL builder (include, no guard on caller)
1. If `ReportID` is set, it runs the spec query and then the columns query.
2. If `DB_num_rows($ColsResult)==0`:
   - It shows prnMsg "The report does not have any output columns...".
   - It links to `SalesAnalReptCols.php?ReportID=…` and to `index.php`.
   - It includes `header.php` and `footer.php`, then exits.
3. If `DB_num_rows($ColsResult)>10`:
   - It shows prnMsg "The report cannot have more than 10 columns...".
   - It shows the same links, then exits.
4. If `groupbydata2!='Not Used'`:
   - It appends `GetFieldSQL(groupbydata2,3)`.
   - It appends the `GetHavingSQL` bounds to WHERE.
   - It appends `GetGroupBySQL` to GROUP BY.
   - Otherwise it sets col3 and col4 to 0 and forces `groupbydata3='Not Used'`.
5. If `groupbydata3!='Not Used'`, it does the same at column index 5.
   - Otherwise it sets col5 and col6 to 0 and forces `groupbydata4='Not Used'`.
6. If `groupbydata4!='Not Used'`, it does the same at column index 7.
   - Otherwise it sets col7 and col8 to 0.
7. For each column, if `$Cols['calculation']==0`, it emits `SUM(CASE WHEN salesanalysis.periodno >= periodfrom AND periodno <= periodto AND budgetoractual=… THEN GetDataSQL(datatype) ELSE 0 END) AS col(colno+8)`.
   - The other `calculation` values are not shown. The source chunk ends mid-loop.

**Mapping functions**
- `GetDataSQL`: 'Quantity', 'Gross Value', 'Net Value', 'Gross Profit', 'Cost', 'Discount'.
- `GetFieldSQL`, `GetHavingSQL` and `GetGroupBySQL`: 'Sales Area', 'Product Code', 'Customer Code', 'Sales Type', 'Product Type', 'Customer Branch', 'Sales Person'.
- A value outside these lists falls through the switch and returns null silently.

### UIGeneralFunctions
- `AddAttributesToField`:
  - If `$AutoFocus==true`, it adds `autofocus`.
  - If `$Required==true`, it adds `required`.
  - If `$TabIndex!=''`, it adds `tabindex`.
- `FieldToSelectOneEntryFromArray`: an option is selected when `strtoupper($SelectedValue)==strtoupper($Entry)`.
- `FieldToSelectOneCurrency`:
  - If `$SelectedValue` is not set, it adds a selected "Not Yet Selected" option with value "".
  - A currency is selected when `currabrev==$SelectedValue`.
- `FieldToSelectOneCustomerType`:
  - If `$Required==true`, it adds an "All Customer Types" option (value "All").
  - Otherwise, if `$SelectedValue` is not set, it adds the same option, selected.
  - A type is selected when `typeid==$SelectedValue`.
- `FieldToSelectOneDate`: it calls `FormatDateForSQL($SelectedValue)`.
- `FieldToSelectOneFile`: it generates a file input.
- `FieldToSelectOneGLAccount`:
  - It always joins `glaccountusers` with `userid=$_SESSION['UserID']`.
  - `$Filter` selects the extra condition:
    - 'ALL' adds none.
    - 'BS' adds `accountgroups.pandl=0`.
    - 'P&L' adds `pandl=1`.
    - 'VIEW' adds `glaccountusers.canview=1`.
    - 'UPDATE' adds `glaccountusers.canupd=1`.
    - Any other value adds none.
  - The label `accountcode - accountname` is passed through `htmlspecialchars`.
- `FieldToSelectOneGLAccountGroup`:
  - It orders by `sequenceintb ASC`.
  - If `$Required==true`, it adds a "Not Yet Selected" option with value "".
  - Otherwise, if `$SelectedValue` is not set, it adds that option, selected.
  - A group is selected when `groupname==$SelectedValue`.

### UpgradeDB_* (all functions are unguarded)

These are the checks shared across the mysql, mysqli, mariadb and postgres variants, with differences noted.

**Existence checks**
- `NewSecurityToken` inserts only if no row exists with that `tokenid`.
- `NewSysType` inserts only if no row exists with that `typeid`.
- `NewScript` inserts only if no row exists with that `script`.
- `RemoveScript` deletes only if the script row exists.
- `NewModule` runs only if no `modulelink` row exists. For each `secroleid` in `securityroles` it runs `UPDATE modules SET sequence=sequence+1 WHERE sequence>=$Sequence AND secroleid=…`, then INSERTs.
- `NewMenuItem` runs only if no row matches `modulelink`, `menusection` and `url`. For each role it bumps the sequence (scoped by `modulelink` and `menusection`) and then INSERTs.
  - The mysql variant's UPDATE uses `link=$Link AND section=$Section`. These are not the names of the `menuitems` columns (`modulelink` and `menusection`), which the other three variants use.
- `RemoveMenuItem` deletes only if a row exists. In mariadb, mysql and mysqli, a loop over `securityroles` issues the same DELETE once per role. The DELETE is not filtered by `secroleid`.
- `UpdateMenuCaption` runs an unconditional UPDATE of caption from old to new.
- `CreateTrigger` creates the trigger only if `information_schema.triggers` has no row for that name and schema.

**Existence checks for tables and columns**
- `AddColumn` runs only if `DB_table_exists`. It then adds the column if `isset($SQLFile)` or the column does not exist.
  - `DEFAULT` is added only if `$Type!='text'` and `$Default!=''`. `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP` is left unquoted.
- `AddCalculatedColumn` follows the same existence rule.
  - mariadb adds `PERSISTENT`.
  - mysqli adds `STORED`.
- `AddIndex` runs only if the table exists and the index is absent.
- `DropIndex` runs if the index exists.
- `DropColumn` runs if `isset($SQLFile)` or `DB_num_rows != 0`.
- `ChangeColumnSize` runs if `CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH <> $Size`.
- `ChangeColumnName` runs if the old column exists and the new one does not.
  - If the type is TIMESTAMP, it uses `DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`.
  - It adds `AUTO_INCREMENT` only if `$AutoIncrement` is non-empty.
- `ChangeColumnType` runs if `DATA_TYPE <> $Type`.
  - It omits `DEFAULT` if `$Default==''`.
- `ChangeColumnDefault` runs if `COLUMN_DEFAULT <> $Default`.
- `RemoveAutoIncrement` has identical logic to `ChangeColumnDefault`.

**Configuration**
- `NewConfigValue` inserts if no `confname` row exists.
- `ChangeConfigValue` updates if no row exists with that `confname` AND `confvalue=new`.
- `ChangeConfigName` updates if no row has `confname=$NewConfName`.
- `DeleteConfigValue` deletes only when `DB_num_rows(SELECT confname=$ConfName) == 0`. That runs the DELETE when the name does not exist and prints "already removed" when it does exist. The condition is inverted.

**Tables and constraints**
- `CreateTable($Table,$SQL,$CharacterSet='utf8mb4')` runs only when `SHOW TABLES` returns 0 rows.
  - It wraps the CREATE in `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys` and `DB_ReinstateForeignKeys` and appends `ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=$CharacterSet`.
  - The postgres file's variant takes only `$Table` and `$SQL`, with the charset fixed to `utf8`.
- `ConstraintExists` reads `information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS`.
- `DropConstraint` runs `DROP FOREIGN KEY` if the constraint exists.
- `AddConstraint` runs if the constraint does not exist. Array `$Field` and `$ReferenceField` values are imploded with ','.
- `UpdateField` runs only if `DB_table_exists`. It then updates only if the current value differs from `$NewValue`.
  - If the column check fails and `isset($SQLFile)`, it runs the UPDATE unchecked.
- `DeleteRecords` deletes if `SELECT … WHERE $Criteria` returns more than 0 rows.
- `DropTable` runs if `SHOW TABLES` returns more than 0 rows.
- `InsertRecord` checks `CheckFields=CheckValues`. It inserts if no row matches or `isset($SQLFile)`. Values go through `DB_escape_string`.
- `DropPrimaryKey` drops only if the current key columns equal `$OldKey` and the count matches.
- `AddPrimaryKey` adds the key if the count of existing key columns `!= sizeOf($Fields)`.
- `RenameTable`:
  - If both the new and old tables exist, it drops the old table.
  - If the new table does not exist, it runs RENAME.
  - Otherwise it reports info.
- `SetAutoIncStart`:
  - If `MAX(field) > $StartNumber`, it reports a warning and does not alter.
  - Otherwise it runs `ALTER TABLE … AUTO_INCREMENT=$StartNumber`.
- `CharacterSet($Table)` returns `TABLE_COLLATION`.

**Postgres file**
- It holds `CharacterSet`, `CreateTrigger`, the `New*`/`Remove*` helpers, `AddColumn` and `AddIndex`.
- It also holds a MySQL-style set that covers the index, column, config, `CreateTable` and constraint functions listed above.
- It also holds `SetAutoIncStart` and `OutputResult`.
- Despite the name, it uses MySQL syntax: backticks, `SHOW INDEX`, `SHOW TABLES`, `information_schema`, `DROP FOREIGN KEY`.

## Order and failure

- Each helper checks state first and then makes one `executeSQL($SQL,false)` call.
  - A response of 0 gives `OutputResult(...,'success')`.
  - Any other response gives `OutputResult(...,'error')` with the SQL, in most variants.
  - There is no retry, no transaction and no rollback.
- `executeSQL($SQL)` without the second argument is used in `DropPrimaryKey`, `AddPrimaryKey` and `DropTable`. What that argument does is not shown (behaviour not in this topic).
- `NewModule`, `NewMenuItem` and `RemoveMenuItem` loop over `securityroles`.
  - Roles already processed stay changed if a later role fails.
  - The result is reported as success or error, per iteration or for the last one.
- `DB_query` and `executeSQL` failures are not handled in the report builder or `UIGeneralFunctions`. They pass to the caller.
- Report builder: an invalid `ReportID` gives null results. Reading `$ReportSpec` and `$Cols` keys without checking will raise warnings or errors.

## Connections

- **Tables read or written:**
  - Report builder reads `reportheaders`, `reportcolumns`, `salesanalysis` and the lookup tables.
  - `UIGeneralFunctions` reads `currencies`, `companies`, `debtortype`, `chartmaster`, `accountgroups`, `glaccountusers`.
  - Upgrade helpers write `securitytokens`, `systypes`, `scripts`, `modules`, `menuitems` and `config`, and read `securityroles`.
  - Upgrade helpers also read `information_schema` for tables, columns, triggers, key usage and constraints.
- **Builder to its includers:** it hands back SQL fragments and column counts. The PDF and CSV generators and `report_runner.php` use them.
- **Other callees (behaviour not in this topic):** `DB_query`, `DB_num_rows`, `DB_fetch_array`, `DB_fetch_row`, `DB_table_exists`, `DB_escape_string`, `DB_IgnoreForeignKeys`, `DB_ReinstateForeignKeys`, `executeSQL`, `prnMsg`, `FormatDateForSQL`.
- **Upgrade file selection:** `$DBType` picks the file in `Z_UpgradeDatabase.php` and `install/pages/page_6.php`. Only one is loaded per run.
- **Report editors:** the builder links to `SalesAnalReptCols.php` and to `index.php`.

## Conclusions

- **Report builder scope.** Despite its name, it is shared by four live paths: the interactive page, the PDF email, the CSV email and the CLI runner.
  - Only `SalesAnalysis_UserDefined.php` checks `AllowedPageSecurityTokens`.
  - The two mail scripts and `bin/report_runner.php` are not shown to do such a check, so they take a `ReportID` from the caller without a permission check.
  - The runner still needs `session.php`.
- **Four-column limit.** The report is limited to 10 output columns.
  - It supports 4 grouping levels, and each deeper level only applies if the shallower one is used.
  - If level 2 is 'Not Used', levels 3 and 4 are dropped even if they are set.
- **`calculation` values other than 0.** Only `calculation==0` is shown. Other values are not shown, so reports using them are not described here.
- **Same-input behaviour.**
  - The upgrade helpers are mostly idempotent. A second run reports 'info', which the session counts as a warning because `OutputResult` counts anything other than 'error' or 'success' as a warning.
  - `UpdateMenuCaption` is idempotent in effect.
  - `ChangeConfigName` and `DeleteConfigValue` are not idempotent.
  - `RemoveMenuItem` runs the same DELETE once per role.
- **`NewModule` and `NewMenuItem` duplicate check.** They check existence of one row for `modulelink` (plus `menusection` and `url` for menu items) across all roles. A partial earlier run that created rows for only some roles blocks a repeat run, and the remaining roles never get the entry.
- **Variant differences.** Where several upgrade files do the same job, the differences are:
  - mariadb and mysqli use `PERSISTENT` or `STORED`.
  - The postgres file's `CreateTable` has no `$CharacterSet` parameter.
  - The mysql variant of `NewMenuItem` uses column names `link` and `section` in its UPDATE.
  - A fix to one file does not reach the others.
- **Condition problems the condensations flag.**
  - `DropColumn` and `ChangeColumnName`/`ChangeColumnType` logic is called inverted or unsafe in the mysql and postgres files.
  - `DeleteConfigValue` is called inverted.
  - `ChangeConfigValue` tests the value with `confvalue=$NewConfigValue`.
- **SQL injection.** It exists throughout. Names and values are concatenated into SQL, except `InsertRecord` values, which use `DB_escape_string`.
- **GL account filter.** `FieldToSelectOneGLAccount` lists only accounts the user has a `glaccountusers` row for. An unknown `$Filter` value gives no extra condition, so the list is not narrowed by P&L, balance sheet or permission.

## Hazards

- `$_GET['ReportID']` goes unescaped into SQL, so injection is possible via `SalesAnalysis_UserDefined.php`.
- Bounds (`lower1..4`, `upper1..4`) and column fields go unescaped into the WHERE and SELECT clauses.
- There is no transaction around the per-role loops, so partial application is possible.
- The inverted `DeleteConfigValue` condition can delete nothing, or run DELETE when the name is absent.
- `NewModule` and `NewMenuItem` can leave roles half-populated, and a repeat run then skips them.
- `RemoveMenuItem` repeats the same DELETE for every role.
- The `OutputResult` counters live in the session, so the 'error' messages are kept but other messages are not.

1	# webERP credit notes: entry screen, posting, and delete utility (SelectCreditItems.php, Z_DeleteCreditNote.php)
2	
3	Part of [webERP: sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing, master data, reporting, API…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.
4	
5	`webERP/SelectCreditItems.php` builds a manual credit note in the session. It selects the customer, adds stock lines, edits prices, quantities, discounts, taxes and freight, and on `ProcessCredit` posts the credit note as transaction type 11. `webERP/Z_DeleteCreditNote.php` is a separate admin utility that reverses a posted type 11 credit note. The posting code writes to debtortrans and the stock, analysis and GL tables. Controlled (serial) lines are handed to `webERP/CreditItemsControlled.php`.
6	
7	## Contract
8	**Into SelectCreditItems.php**
9	- GET:
10	  - `identifier`: session key suffix. If empty, `$identifier = date('U')`.
11	  - `NewCredit`.
12	- POST:
13	  - Buttons and actions: `ProcessCredit`, `ChangeCustomer`, `CancelCredit`, `Quick`, `NewCredit`, `SearchCust`, `JustSelectedACustomer`, `Search`, `QuickEntry`, `PartSearch`, `Delete`.
14	  - Customer search: `Keywords`, `CustCode`; selection through `SubmitCustomerSelection<i>`, `SelectedCustomer<i>`, `SelectedBranch<i>`.
15	  - Item search: `StockCat` ('All' or a category id), `StockCode`, `NewItem`.
16	  - Quick entry: `part_N`, `qty_N`, for N = 1..`$_SESSION['QuickEntries']`.
17	  - Header fields: `SalesPerson`, `Location`, `ChargeFreightCost`, `CreditType` (`Return`, `WriteOff`, `ReverseOverCharge`), `WriteOffGLCode`, `CreditText`.
18	  - Per line:
19	    - `Quantity_<LineNumber>`
20	    - `Narrative_<LineNumber>`
21	    - `Price_<LineNumber>` (optional)
22	    - `Discount_<LineNumber>`
23	    - `Gross` (flag)
24	    - `<LineNumber><TaxKey>_TaxRate`
25	    - `FreightTaxRate<TaxCalculationOrder>`
26	- Session:
27	  - `$_SESSION['CreditItems'.$identifier]` is a Cart object with these properties: DebtorNo, Branch, CustomerName, DefaultSalesType, DefaultCurrency, CurrDecimalPlaces, CurrencyRate, DeliverTo, BrAdd1-6, PhoneNo, Email, SalesPerson, Location, TaxGroup, DispatchTaxProvince, LineItems, LineCounter, FreightCost, FreightTaxes, total, totalVolume, totalWeight, ItemsOrdered, CreditType.
28	  - Other session keys: `RequireCustomerSelection`, `FormID`, `CompanyRecord['gllink_stock'|'gllink_debtors'|'debtorsact'|'freightact']`, `CurrencyRate`, `SO_AllowSameItemMultipleTimes`, `QuickEntries`, `part_pics_dir`, `SalesmanLogin`, `UserID`, `InvoicePortraitFormat`, `DefaultDateFormat`.
29	- The menu entry is `/SelectCreditItems.php?NewCredit=Yes` ("Create A Credit Note", AR Transactions, seq 2). It is defined in `webERP/install/sql/data/menuitems.sql`.
30	- `webERP/Credit_Invoice.php` initialises a credit note from an invoice into the same kind of session cart. It is a different path. Its condensation was not read.
31	
32	**Out of SelectCreditItems.php**
33	- Reads: custbranch, debtorsmaster, currencies, locations, stockmaster, stockcategory, locstock, bom, chartmaster joined with accountgroups, salesman, locationusers.
34	- Writes:
35	  - debtortrans, debtortranstaxes
36	  - stockmoves, stockmovestaxes
37	  - stockserialitems, stockserialmoves
38	  - locstock
39	  - salesanalysis
40	  - gltrans
41	- Credit note posting values:
42	  - debtortrans: `type='11'`, all amounts negated (ovamount, ovgst, ovfreight, tax), `prd` from GetPeriod, `tpe` from DefaultSalesType, `inputdate` now. The id comes from `DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans','id')`.
43	  - Transaction number from `GetNextTransNo(11)`.
44	  - debtortranstaxes: one row per `$TaxTotals` tax authority.
45	  - stockmoves: `type=11`.
46	  - stockmoves for `ReverseOverCharge`: `hidemovt=1`, `newqoh = QtyOnHandPrior`.
47	  - Return or write-off with MBflag 'M' or 'B': `newqoh = QtyOnHandPrior + Quantity`.
48	  - Return or write-off with any other MBflag: `newqoh` is omitted from the INSERT.
49	  - stockmovestaxes: one row per tax of the line.
50	  - Serial lines: stockserialitems is inserted (`$MyRow[0]==0`) or updated (`quantity=quantity+BundleQty`), then stockserialmoves is inserted.
51	- Link to CreditItemsControlled.php: `CreditItemsControlled.php?LineNo=<n>&identifier=<id>`.
52	
53	**Z_DeleteCreditNote.php**
54	- In: GET `CreditNoteNo` (no format validation).
55	- Reads: debtortrans (`order_`, `id`), stockmoves (`stockid`, `loccode`, `debtorno`, `branchcode`, `prd`, `qty`), and information_schema.
56	- Deletes and updates:
57	  - custallocns, debtortranstaxes, debtortrans
58	  - salesorderdetails (`qtyinvoiced` updated)
59	  - locstock (quantity updated)
60	  - salesanalysis, stockmovestaxes, stockserialmoves, stockmoves
61	  - gltrans (`type=11 AND typeno=CreditNoteNo`)
62	
63	## Entry points
64	**SelectCreditItems.php** (checks in the order they run)
65	1. `if empty($_GET['identifier'])` -> `$identifier = date('U')`; else it is taken from GET.
66	2. `if isset($_POST['ProcessCredit']) AND !isset($_SESSION['CreditItems'.$identifier])` -> message "This credit note has already been processed", exit.
67	3. `if isset($_GET['NewCredit'])` -> unset the existing CreditItems session and start a new Cart.
68	4. `if !isset($_SESSION['CreditItems'.$identifier])` -> new Cart, `RequireCustomerSelection = 1`.
69	5. `if isset($_POST['ChangeCustomer'])` -> `RequireCustomerSelection = 1`.
70	6. `if isset($_POST['CancelCredit'])` -> unset the session, new Cart, `RequireCustomerSelection = 1`.
71	7. `if isset($_POST['SearchCust']) AND RequireCustomerSelection == 1` -> run the customer search.
72	8. `if isset($_POST['SalesPerson'])` -> set Cart SalesPerson.
73	9. `if isset($_POST['Search'])` -> stock search.
74	10. `if isset($_POST['QuickEntry'])` -> quick-entry processing.
75	11. `if isset($_POST['Delete'])` -> `remove_from_cart`.
76	12. `isset($_POST['ChargeFreightCost'])` -> set FreightCost; `Location` change; per-line updates; freight tax updates; `NewItem` add.
77	13. The items form is displayed `if ItemsOrdered > 0 OR isset($_POST['NewItem'])`.
78	14. `ProcessCredit` is shown only `if !isset($_POST['ProcessCredit']) AND $OKToProcess == true`.
79	15. Posting begins when `isset($_POST['ProcessCredit']) AND $OKToProcess==true`.
80	16. No permission check is shown anywhere in the screen.
81	
82	**Z_DeleteCreditNote.php**
83	- `if !isset($_GET['CreditNoteNo'])` -> message that the parameter is required. The condensation does not say whether the script stops there.
84	- No authorization or confirmation check is shown. It is marked for manual use by administrators.
85	
86	## Decisions
87	**Customer search**
88	- Keywords and CustCode both set -> message that keywords take preference.
89	- Both empty -> message "At least one Customer Name keyword OR an extract of a Customer Code must be entered for the search".
90	- `mb_strlen(Keywords) > 0` -> `custbranch.brname LIKE '%kw%'` (spaces become %) `AND custbranch.disabletrans = '0'`. Else if CustCode is non-empty -> `custbranch.debtorno LIKE '%code%' AND disabletrans='0'`. Branches with `disabletrans` other than '0' are never listed.
91	- Result rows == 1 -> that customer is selected and `JustSelectedACustomer = true`. Rows == 0 -> "Sorry ... there are no customer branch records…".
92	- `JustSelectedACustomer` set without `$SelectedCustomer` -> loop over `SubmitCustomerSelection<i>`. If none is found -> error "Unable to identify the selected customer".
93	- Customer chosen -> set DebtorNo, Branch, `RequireCustomerSelection=0`. Load the customer details with an INNER JOIN of custbranch, locations, debtorsmaster and currencies, so a branch with no default location or currency is not loaded. Then call `GetFreightTaxes()`.
94	- The customer form is shown if `RequireCustomerSelection==1 OR DebtorNo unset OR DebtorNo==''`. The table prints the customer name only when `$LastCustomer != name`.
95	
96	**Stock search**
97	- Keywords and StockCode both non-empty -> a message says keywords take precedence.
98	- Keywords non-empty -> `stockmaster.description LIKE` (spaces become %).
99	- Else StockCode non-empty -> `stockmaster.stockid LIKE %code%`.
100	- Else no text filter. `StockCat=='All'` adds no category filter; otherwise `categoryid='...'`.
101	- The search query is restricted to `stockcategory.stocktype='F' OR 'D'`.
102	- 0 rows -> info message. 1 row -> `NewItem` is set to that stockid.
103	
104	**Quick entry**
105	- Loop i=1..QuickEntries. The inner do-while skips a row while `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(qty)) AND qty<=0 AND strlen(part)!=0`. Because the three tests are joined with AND, it behaves oddly. Examples: a non-numeric quantity such as text normally filters to 0, which satisfies `<=0` and so is skipped, but a non-empty `part` with a positive numeric quantity is taken.
106	- `NewItem = trim(part)`, `NewItemQty = filter_number_format(qty)`. `strlen(NewItem)==0` -> break.
107	
108	**Adding an item**
109	- `SO_AllowSameItemMultipleTimes==0 AND strcasecmp(StockID, NewItem)==0` for any line -> `AlreadyOnThisCredit=1` and a warning. The item is not added.
110	- Otherwise select from stockmaster. On a hit, call `add_to_cart(...)` with price from `GetPrice(NewItem, DebtorNo, Branch)`. On a miss -> warning that the item does not exist.
111	- In the edit path, `add_to_cart` is called with quantity 1 and discount 0. The quick-entry path passes a different argument list (`-1`, 'No', taxcatid).
112	- `add_to_cart` returns 1 -> `GetTaxes(LineNumber)`. `controlled==1` -> `Quantity=0` (the user enters serials on `CreditItemsControlled.php`).
113	
114	**Editing lines**
115	- `POST Location != current` -> select `taxprovinceid FROM locations WHERE loccode='<Location>'`, set DispatchTaxProvince, and call `GetTaxes` on every line.
116	- `Price_<n>` set and `Gross==true` -> `price = price / (TaxTotalPercent+1)`. TaxTotalPercent adds `(1+prior)*TaxRate` where `TaxOnTax==1`, else `TaxRate`.
117	- Tax rate input applies only if `is_numeric(...)`: `TaxRate = value/100`.
118	- `Quantity<0 OR Price<0 OR DiscountPercentage>100 OR DiscountPercentage<0` -> warning, no update. Otherwise `update_cart_item(LineNumber, Quantity, Price, Discount/100, Narrative, 'No', ItemDue, POLine, 0, identifier)`.
119	- Display:
120	  - `LineTotal = round(Quantity*Price*(1-DiscountPercent), CurrDecimalPlaces)`.
121	  - `Controlled==0` -> editable quantity box. `Controlled==1` -> link to CreditItemsControlled.php plus a hidden `Quantity_<n>`.
122	  - Tax on a line: `TaxOnTax==1` -> `TaxRate*(LineTotal+TaxLineTotal)`, else `TaxRate*LineTotal`. Freight tax uses the same rule on `FreightCost`.
123	  - `!isset(POST ChargeFreightCost) AND !isset(FreightCost)` -> `ChargeFreightCost=0`.
124	  - The CreditType selector lists Return first when `CreditType` is unset or 'Return', and otherwise puts the chosen type first.
125	
126	**Form fields by CreditType**
127	- CreditType unset or 'Return' -> Location select. It lists locations INNER JOIN locationusers `WHERE userid=$_SESSION['UserID'] AND canupd=1`.
128	- CreditType 'WriteOff' -> WriteOffGLCode select (chartmaster INNER JOIN accountgroups `pandl=1`). `ReverseOverCharge` shows neither select.
129	- SalesPerson select covers `salesman WHERE current=1`. `!isset(POST SalesPerson) AND SalesmanLogin!=NULL` -> Cart SalesPerson = `SalesmanLogin`.
130	- `CreditType=='WriteOff' AND !isset(WriteOffGLCode)` -> info message and `OKToProcess=false`, so the ProcessCredit button is not shown.
131	- Search form is shown `if isset(PartSearch) AND PartSearch!='' AND !isset(ProcessCredit)`. Otherwise, if `!isset(ProcessCredit)`, the quick-entry form is shown.
132	
133	**Posting**
134	- `gllink_stock==1 AND CreditType=='WriteOff' AND (!isset(WriteOffGLCode) OR ==''` -> error, footer, exit before any DB writes.
135	- Lines are processed only `if $CreditLine->Quantity > 0`. Lines with quantity 0 (including controlled lines with no serials entered) or negative are dropped.
136	- Stock side (`StockMoves`):
137	  - `CreditType=='ReverseOverCharge'` -> stockmoves with `hidemovt=1` only. There is no locstock change and no taxes or serials.
138	  - `MBflag in ('M','B')` -> read `locstock.quantity` for `QtyOnHandPrior`; one row -> use it, else 0. Other MBflag -> 0.
139	  - Return with `MBflag 'B' OR 'M'` -> `locstock.quantity += Quantity`.
140	  - Return with `MBflag 'A'` -> read the BOM components valid at today's date (`effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE AND effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE`). For each component: stockmoves (`reference "Assembly: <StockID>"`, `qty = component qty * line qty`, `show_on_inv_crds=0`, `newqoh = prior + qty`) and `locstock` increase. The line `StandardCost` is replaced by the sum of component standard costs. This replaced cost is used by the later GL posting.
141	  - WriteOff with 'B' or 'M' -> stockmoves `type 11`, `qty = -Quantity`, `newqoh = QtyOnHandPrior`. WriteOff with 'A' -> same without `newqoh`.
142	  - `Controlled==1 AND MBflag in ('M','B')` -> loop `SerialItems`.
143	  - Return: SELECT COUNT from stockserialitems. Zero -> INSERT, else `quantity+BundleQty`. Then insert stockserialmoves.
144	  - WriteOff: `stockserialitems.quantity -= BundleQty` and stockserialmoves `moveqty -BundleQty`.
145	  - `SalesValue = Price*Quantity/CurrencyRate` if `CurrencyRate>0`, else 0.
146	- Sales analysis. SELECT count where stockid, salesperson, typeabbrev, periodno, debtorno, branchcode, area and `budgetoractual=1` match:
147	  - Row exists and `ReverseOverCharge` -> `amt=amt-SalesValue`, `disc=disc-(DiscountPercent*SalesValue)`.
148	  - Row exists and not `ReverseOverCharge` -> Amt, Cost, Qty, Disc are all decremented.
149	  - No row and `ReverseOverCharge` -> INSERT with negative value and discount, zero qty.
150	  - No row and not `ReverseOverCharge` -> INSERT with negative value, cost, qty and discount.
151	- Stock GL (COGS and stock):
152	  - `gllink_stock==1 AND StandardCost!=0 AND CreditType!='ReverseOverCharge'` -> `GetCOGSGLAccount(Area, StockID, DefaultSalesType)`. gltrans type 11 at `-(StandardCost*Quantity)` on the COGS account.
153	  - `CreditType=='WriteOff'` -> gltrans on `WriteOffGLCode` at `+StandardCost*Quantity`.
154	  - `CreditType!='WriteOff'` (goods return, which includes ReverseOverCharge) -> `GetStockGLCode(StockID)`, gltrans on `stockact` at `+StandardCost*Quantity`.
155	  - The COGS credit and the stock or write-off debit are both inside the `gllink_stock==1` branch in the condensation. The write-off and stock-return inserts as described are not shown as separately guarded, so for `ReverseOverCharge` the stock-account debit can be posted without the COGS credit. A reader should check the source to confirm.
156	- Sales GL:
157	  - `gllink_debtors==1 AND Price!=0` -> `GetSalesGLAccount(Area, StockID, DefaultSalesType)` returns `salesglcode` and `discountglcode`. gltrans type 11 is inserted for the sale.
158	  - `DiscountPercent!=0` -> a second discount gltrans at a negative amount. Narratives are truncated to 200 characters.
159	- Header GL (`gllink_debtors==1`):
160	  - `(total + FreightCost + TaxTotal) != 0` -> `debtorsact` at `-(total+freight+tax)/CurrencyRate`.
161	  - `FreightCost != 0` -> `freightact` at `FreightCost/CurrencyRate`.
162	  - Each `TaxTotals[TaxAuthID] != 0` -> `TaxGLCodes[TaxAuthID]` at `amount/CurrencyRate`.
163	  - Then `EnsureGLEntriesBalance(11, CreditNo)`, `DB_Txn_Commit()`, unset LineItems and the CreditItems session, and show confirmation with print and re-entry links.
164	
165	**Z_DeleteCreditNote.php**
166	- Looks up debtortrans `transno=CreditNoteNo AND type='11'`. Stockmovements are looked up by `type='11'`.
167	- Inside `DB_Txn_Begin` ... `DB_Txn_Commit`, it deletes in this order: custallocns, debtortranstaxes, debtortrans. It then loops each stockmove and updates `salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced` and `locstock`. Next it deletes salesanalysis, stockmovestaxes, stockserialmoves, stockmoves, and finally gltrans.
168	- The user is told to repost GL from the credit note's period.
169	
170	## Order and failure
171	- `DB_Txn_Begin()` is called in posting. Then come `GetNextTransNo(11)`, `GetPeriod()`, the debtortrans INSERT (id from `DB_Last_Insert_ID`), debtortranstaxes, and the per-line stock, analysis and GL inserts. The header GL entries, `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` and `DB_Txn_Commit` come last. The session is cleared only after commit.
172	- Every posting `DB_query` carries a "CRITICAL ERROR! NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE: …" message and `true` as the fourth parameter. The meaning of `true` is not shown in the condensation. No custom handler or rollback is shown. Stock and serial inserts use `DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno')` with no check of the value.
173	- Before posting, the only early exits are the WriteOff-without-GL-code exit and the "already processed" exit.
174	- `GetPrice`, `GetTaxes`, `GetImageLink` and `glob` have no error handling.
175	- Z_DeleteCreditNote: every query passes `ErrMsg` and `true`. A failure leaves the uncommitted transaction. No existence check is shown.
176	
177	## Connections
178	- `webERP/CreditItemsControlled.php`:
179	  - Reached by link from controlled lines, with `identifier` and `LineNo`.
180	  - Guards:
181	    - Missing `identifier` -> error and exit.
182	    - Missing `LineNo` (GET or POST) -> error and exit.
183	    - No session cart `CreditItems<id>` -> error and exit.
184	    - Line `Controlled != 1` -> warning and exit.
185	  - Includes `includes/InputSerialItems.php` with `LocationOut = Cart Location`, `ItemMustExist = SESSION['CreditingControlledItems_MustExist']`, `StockID`, `InOutModifier=1`, `ShowExisting=false`, `IsCredit=true`.
186	  - Delete: GET `Delete` unsets that serial item. The total then goes to `LineItems[LineNo]->QtyDispatched` when `CreditLink=='Credit_Invoice.php?identifier=<id>'`, else to `Quantity`.
187	- `webERP/Credit_Invoice.php`: the other path that fills `CreditItems<id>` (from an invoice). Detail not read.
188	- Helper functions whose behaviour is outside this topic: `GetPrice`, `GetNextTransNo(11)`, `GetPeriod`, `GetCOGSGLAccount`, `GetStockGLCode`, `GetSalesGLAccount`, `EnsureGLEntriesBalance`, `DB_Txn_*`, and the Cart methods (`add_to_cart`, `update_cart_item`, `remove_from_cart`, `GetTaxes`, `GetFreightTaxes`). The Cart class file was not found by name.
189	- `webERP/install/sql/data/scripts.sql` lists Z_DeleteCreditNote.php as a script. It has no menu entry in the files read.
190	
191	## Conclusions
192	- Lines with `Quantity <= 0` are dropped from posting. A controlled line starts at Quantity 0 and is dropped unless serials are entered, so it posts only after serial entry.
193	- `ReverseOverCharge` changes no stock quantity. It writes a hidden stock move and a sales analysis reduction of amount and discount only. It skips the COGS credit, but see the note above on the stock-account debit.
194	- The location list is limited to locations with `canupd=1` for the user. The POSTed `Location` is later used without re-checking that permission.
195	- The posting path has no duplicate guard beyond the session being unset. A repeat POST gets "already processed" only because the session key is gone. With a reused `identifier` from a second tab, a second credit can be processed.
196	- `Z_DeleteCreditNote` removes salesanalysis rows. The source marks this "unreliable" because rows hold totals. It also zeroes nothing that the original posting left in `Credit_Invoice` links.
197	- Z_DeleteCreditNote reverses locstock with the stored move quantity and reverses `salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced`. It does not undo bank or other GL outside type 11.
198	- All user input goes straight into SQL (`NewItem`, `Location`, `CreditNoteNo`) without escaping. This is a SQL-injection risk.
199	- The `DB_query` fourth parameter `true` and the lack of an explicit rollback mean a failure mid-posting leaves partial data unless `DB_query` aborts and rolls back (behaviour not in this topic).

203	- Serial and tax inserts rely on an unchecked `StkMoveNo`.
204	- Serial `BundleRef` and `WriteOffGLCode` are not validated against any table.
205	- Nothing is shown that restricts who can run Z_DeleteCreditNote.php, and there is no `CreditNoteNo` existence check.
206	- Z_DeleteCreditNote: a missing credit note number leads to an empty-arguments deletion. If the script does not stop after the "required parameter" message, the later deletes run with an empty number.

# webERP credit notes: entry screen, posting, and delete utility (SelectCreditItems.php, Z_DeleteCreditNote.php)

Part of [webERP: sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing, master data, reporting, API…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

`webERP/SelectCreditItems.php` builds a manual credit note in the session. It selects the customer, adds stock lines, edits prices, quantities, discounts, taxes and freight, and on `ProcessCredit` posts the credit note as transaction type 11. `webERP/Z_DeleteCreditNote.php` is a separate admin utility that reverses a posted type 11 credit note. The posting code writes to debtortrans and the stock, analysis and GL tables. Controlled (serial) lines are handed to `webERP/CreditItemsControlled.php`.

## Contract
**Into SelectCreditItems.php**
- GET:
  - `identifier`: session key suffix. If empty, `$identifier = date('U')`.
  - `NewCredit`.
- POST:
  - Buttons and actions: `ProcessCredit`, `ChangeCustomer`, `CancelCredit`, `Quick`, `NewCredit`, `SearchCust`, `JustSelectedACustomer`, `Search`, `QuickEntry`, `PartSearch`, `Delete`.
  - Customer search: `Keywords`, `CustCode`; selection through `SubmitCustomerSelection<i>`, `SelectedCustomer<i>`, `SelectedBranch<i>`.
  - Item search: `StockCat` ('All' or a category id), `StockCode`, `NewItem`.
  - Quick entry: `part_N`, `qty_N`, for N = 1..`$_SESSION['QuickEntries']`.
  - Header fields: `SalesPerson`, `Location`, `ChargeFreightCost`, `CreditType` (`Return`, `WriteOff`, `ReverseOverCharge`), `WriteOffGLCode`, `CreditText`.
  - Per line:
    - `Quantity_<LineNumber>`
    - `Narrative_<LineNumber>`
    - `Price_<LineNumber>` (optional)
    - `Discount_<LineNumber>`
    - `Gross` (flag)
    - `<LineNumber><TaxKey>_TaxRate`
    - `FreightTaxRate<TaxCalculationOrder>`
- Session:
  - `$_SESSION['CreditItems'.$identifier]` is a Cart object with these properties: DebtorNo, Branch, CustomerName, DefaultSalesType, DefaultCurrency, CurrDecimalPlaces, CurrencyRate, DeliverTo, BrAdd1-6, PhoneNo, Email, SalesPerson, Location, TaxGroup, DispatchTaxProvince, LineItems, LineCounter, FreightCost, FreightTaxes, total, totalVolume, totalWeight, ItemsOrdered, CreditType.
  - Other session keys: `RequireCustomerSelection`, `FormID`, `CompanyRecord['gllink_stock'|'gllink_debtors'|'debtorsact'|'freightact']`, `CurrencyRate`, `SO_AllowSameItemMultipleTimes`, `QuickEntries`, `part_pics_dir`, `SalesmanLogin`, `UserID`, `InvoicePortraitFormat`, `DefaultDateFormat`.
- The menu entry is `/SelectCreditItems.php?NewCredit=Yes` ("Create A Credit Note", AR Transactions, seq 2). It is defined in `webERP/install/sql/data/menuitems.sql`.
- `webERP/Credit_Invoice.php` initialises a credit note from an invoice into the same kind of session cart. It is a different path. Its condensation was not read.

**Out of SelectCreditItems.php**
- Reads: custbranch, debtorsmaster, currencies, locations, stockmaster, stockcategory, locstock, bom, chartmaster joined with accountgroups, salesman, locationusers.
- Writes:
  - debtortrans, debtortranstaxes
  - stockmoves, stockmovestaxes
  - stockserialitems, stockserialmoves
  - locstock
  - salesanalysis
  - gltrans
- Credit note posting values:
  - debtortrans: `type='11'`, all amounts negated (ovamount, ovgst, ovfreight, tax), `prd` from GetPeriod, `tpe` from DefaultSalesType, `inputdate` now. The id comes from `DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans','id')`.
  - Transaction number from `GetNextTransNo(11)`.
  - debtortranstaxes: one row per `$TaxTotals` tax authority.
  - stockmoves: `type=11`.
  - stockmoves for `ReverseOverCharge`: `hidemovt=1`, `newqoh = QtyOnHandPrior`.
  - Return or write-off with MBflag 'M' or 'B': `newqoh = QtyOnHandPrior + Quantity`.
  - Return or write-off with any other MBflag: `newqoh` is omitted from the INSERT.
  - stockmovestaxes: one row per tax of the line.
  - Serial lines: stockserialitems is inserted (`$MyRow[0]==0`) or updated (`quantity=quantity+BundleQty`), then stockserialmoves is inserted.
- Link to CreditItemsControlled.php: `CreditItemsControlled.php?LineNo=<n>&identifier=<id>`.

**Z_DeleteCreditNote.php**
- In: GET `CreditNoteNo` (no format validation).
- Reads: debtortrans (`order_`, `id`), stockmoves (`stockid`, `loccode`, `debtorno`, `branchcode`, `prd`, `qty`), and information_schema.
- Deletes and updates:
  - custallocns, debtortranstaxes, debtortrans
  - salesorderdetails (`qtyinvoiced` updated)
  - locstock (quantity updated)
  - salesanalysis, stockmovestaxes, stockserialmoves, stockmoves
  - gltrans (`type=11 AND typeno=CreditNoteNo`)

## Entry points
**SelectCreditItems.php** (checks in the order they run)
1. `if empty($_GET['identifier'])` -> `$identifier = date('U')`; else it is taken from GET.
2. `if isset($_POST['ProcessCredit']) AND !isset($_SESSION['CreditItems'.$identifier])` -> message "This credit note has already been processed", exit.
3. `if isset($_GET['NewCredit'])` -> unset the existing CreditItems session and start a new Cart.
4. `if !isset($_SESSION['CreditItems'.$identifier])` -> new Cart, `RequireCustomerSelection = 1`.
5. `if isset($_POST['ChangeCustomer'])` -> `RequireCustomerSelection = 1`.
6. `if isset($_POST['CancelCredit'])` -> unset the session, new Cart, `RequireCustomerSelection = 1`.
7. `if isset($_POST['SearchCust']) AND RequireCustomerSelection == 1` -> run the customer search.
8. `if isset($_POST['SalesPerson'])` -> set Cart SalesPerson.
9. `if isset($_POST['Search'])` -> stock search.
10. `if isset($_POST['QuickEntry'])` -> quick-entry processing.
11. `if isset($_POST['Delete'])` -> `remove_from_cart`.
12. `isset($_POST['ChargeFreightCost'])` -> set FreightCost; `Location` change; per-line updates; freight tax updates; `NewItem` add.
13. The items form is displayed `if ItemsOrdered > 0 OR isset($_POST['NewItem'])`.
14. `ProcessCredit` is shown only `if !isset($_POST['ProcessCredit']) AND $OKToProcess == true`.
15. Posting begins when `isset($_POST['ProcessCredit']) AND $OKToProcess==true`.
16. No permission check is shown anywhere in the screen.

**Z_DeleteCreditNote.php**
- `if !isset($_GET['CreditNoteNo'])` -> message that the parameter is required. The condensation does not say whether the script stops there.
- No authorization or confirmation check is shown. It is marked for manual use by administrators.

## Decisions
**Customer search**
- Keywords and CustCode both set -> message that keywords take preference.
- Both empty -> message "At least one Customer Name keyword OR an extract of a Customer Code must be entered for the search".
- `mb_strlen(Keywords) > 0` -> `custbranch.brname LIKE '%kw%'` (spaces become %) `AND custbranch.disabletrans = '0'`. Else if CustCode is non-empty -> `custbranch.debtorno LIKE '%code%' AND disabletrans='0'`. Branches with `disabletrans` other than '0' are never listed.
- Result rows == 1 -> that customer is selected and `JustSelectedACustomer = true`. Rows == 0 -> "Sorry ... there are no customer branch records…".
- `JustSelectedACustomer` set without `$SelectedCustomer` -> loop over `SubmitCustomerSelection<i>`. If none is found -> error "Unable to identify the selected customer".
- Customer chosen -> set DebtorNo, Branch, `RequireCustomerSelection=0`. Load the customer details with an INNER JOIN of custbranch, locations, debtorsmaster and currencies, so a branch with no default location or currency is not loaded. Then call `GetFreightTaxes()`.
- The customer form is shown if `RequireCustomerSelection==1 OR DebtorNo unset OR DebtorNo==''`. The table prints the customer name only when `$LastCustomer != name`.

**Stock search**
- Keywords and StockCode both non-empty -> a message says keywords take precedence.
- Keywords non-empty -> `stockmaster.description LIKE` (spaces become %).
- Else StockCode non-empty -> `stockmaster.stockid LIKE %code%`.
- Else no text filter. `StockCat=='All'` adds no category filter; otherwise `categoryid='...'`.
- The search query is restricted to `stockcategory.stocktype='F' OR 'D'`.
- 0 rows -> info message. 1 row -> `NewItem` is set to that stockid.

**Quick entry**
- Loop i=1..QuickEntries. The inner do-while skips a row while `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(qty)) AND qty<=0 AND strlen(part)!=0`. Because the three tests are joined with AND, it behaves oddly. Examples: a non-numeric quantity such as text normally filters to 0, which satisfies `<=0` and so is skipped, but a non-empty `part` with a positive numeric quantity is taken.
- `NewItem = trim(part)`, `NewItemQty = filter_number_format(qty)`. `strlen(NewItem)==0` -> break.

**Adding an item**
- `SO_AllowSameItemMultipleTimes==0 AND strcasecmp(StockID, NewItem)==0` for any line -> `AlreadyOnThisCredit=1` and a warning. The item is not added.
- Otherwise select from stockmaster. On a hit, call `add_to_cart(...)` with price from `GetPrice(NewItem, DebtorNo, Branch)`. On a miss -> warning that the item does not exist.
- In the edit path, `add_to_cart` is called with quantity 1 and discount 0. The quick-entry path passes a different argument list (`-1`, 'No', taxcatid).
- `add_to_cart` returns 1 -> `GetTaxes(LineNumber)`. `controlled==1` -> `Quantity=0` (the user enters serials on `CreditItemsControlled.php`).

**Editing lines**
- `POST Location != current` -> select `taxprovinceid FROM locations WHERE loccode='<Location>'`, set DispatchTaxProvince, and call `GetTaxes` on every line.
- `Price_<n>` set and `Gross==true` -> `price = price / (TaxTotalPercent+1)`. TaxTotalPercent adds `(1+prior)*TaxRate` where `TaxOnTax==1`, else `TaxRate`.
- Tax rate input applies only if `is_numeric(...)`: `TaxRate = value/100`.
- `Quantity<0 OR Price<0 OR DiscountPercentage>100 OR DiscountPercentage<0` -> warning, no update. Otherwise `update_cart_item(LineNumber, Quantity, Price, Discount/100, Narrative, 'No', ItemDue, POLine, 0, identifier)`.
- Display:
  - `LineTotal = round(Quantity*Price*(1-DiscountPercent), CurrDecimalPlaces)`.
  - `Controlled==0` -> editable quantity box. `Controlled==1` -> link to CreditItemsControlled.php plus a hidden `Quantity_<n>`.
  - Tax on a line: `TaxOnTax==1` -> `TaxRate*(LineTotal+TaxLineTotal)`, else `TaxRate*LineTotal`. Freight tax uses the same rule on `FreightCost`.
  - `!isset(POST ChargeFreightCost) AND !isset(FreightCost)` -> `ChargeFreightCost=0`.
  - The CreditType selector lists Return first when `CreditType` is unset or 'Return', and otherwise puts the chosen type first.

**Form fields by CreditType**
- CreditType unset or 'Return' -> Location select. It lists locations INNER JOIN locationusers `WHERE userid=$_SESSION['UserID'] AND canupd=1`.
- CreditType 'WriteOff' -> WriteOffGLCode select (chartmaster INNER JOIN accountgroups `pandl=1`). `ReverseOverCharge` shows neither select.
- SalesPerson select covers `salesman WHERE current=1`. `!isset(POST SalesPerson) AND SalesmanLogin!=NULL` -> Cart SalesPerson = `SalesmanLogin`.
- `CreditType=='WriteOff' AND !isset(WriteOffGLCode)` -> info message and `OKToProcess=false`, so the ProcessCredit button is not shown.
- Search form is shown `if isset(PartSearch) AND PartSearch!='' AND !isset(ProcessCredit)`. Otherwise, if `!isset(ProcessCredit)`, the quick-entry form is shown.

**Posting**
- `gllink_stock==1 AND CreditType=='WriteOff' AND (!isset(WriteOffGLCode) OR ==''` -> error, footer, exit before any DB writes.
- Lines are processed only `if $CreditLine->Quantity > 0`. Lines with quantity 0 (including controlled lines with no serials entered) or negative are dropped.
- Stock side (`StockMoves`):
  - `CreditType=='ReverseOverCharge'` -> stockmoves with `hidemovt=1` only. There is no locstock change and no taxes or serials.
  - `MBflag in ('M','B')` -> read `locstock.quantity` for `QtyOnHandPrior`; one row -> use it, else 0. Other MBflag -> 0.
  - Return with `MBflag 'B' OR 'M'` -> `locstock.quantity += Quantity`.
  - Return with `MBflag 'A'` -> read the BOM components valid at today's date (`effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE AND effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE`). For each component: stockmoves (`reference "Assembly: <StockID>"`, `qty = component qty * line qty`, `show_on_inv_crds=0`, `newqoh = prior + qty`) and `locstock` increase. The line `StandardCost` is replaced by the sum of component standard costs. This replaced cost is used by the later GL posting.
  - WriteOff with 'B' or 'M' -> stockmoves `type 11`, `qty = -Quantity`, `newqoh = QtyOnHandPrior`. WriteOff with 'A' -> same without `newqoh`.
  - `Controlled==1 AND MBflag in ('M','B')` -> loop `SerialItems`.
  - Return: SELECT COUNT from stockserialitems. Zero -> INSERT, else `quantity+BundleQty`. Then insert stockserialmoves.
  - WriteOff: `stockserialitems.quantity -= BundleQty` and stockserialmoves `moveqty -BundleQty`.
  - `SalesValue = Price*Quantity/CurrencyRate` if `CurrencyRate>0`, else 0.
- Sales analysis. SELECT count where stockid, salesperson, typeabbrev, periodno, debtorno, branchcode, area and `budgetoractual=1` match:
  - Row exists and `ReverseOverCharge` -> `amt=amt-SalesValue`, `disc=disc-(DiscountPercent*SalesValue)`.
  - Row exists and not `ReverseOverCharge` -> Amt, Cost, Qty, Disc are all decremented.
  - No row and `ReverseOverCharge` -> INSERT with negative value and discount, zero qty.
  - No row and not `ReverseOverCharge` -> INSERT with negative value, cost, qty and discount.
- Stock GL (COGS and stock):
  - `gllink_stock==1 AND StandardCost!=0 AND CreditType!='ReverseOverCharge'` -> `GetCOGSGLAccount(Area, StockID, DefaultSalesType)`. gltrans type 11 at `-(StandardCost*Quantity)` on the COGS account.
  - `CreditType=='WriteOff'` -> gltrans on `WriteOffGLCode` at `+StandardCost*Quantity`.
  - `CreditType!='WriteOff'` (goods return, which includes ReverseOverCharge) -> `GetStockGLCode(StockID)`, gltrans on `stockact` at `+StandardCost*Quantity`.
  - The COGS credit and the stock or write-off debit are both inside the `gllink_stock==1` branch in the condensation. The write-off and stock-return inserts as described are not shown as separately guarded, so for `ReverseOverCharge` the stock-account debit can be posted without the COGS credit. A reader should check the source to confirm.
- Sales GL:
  - `gllink_debtors==1 AND Price!=0` -> `GetSalesGLAccount(Area, StockID, DefaultSalesType)` returns `salesglcode` and `discountglcode`. gltrans type 11 is inserted for the sale.
  - `DiscountPercent!=0` -> a second discount gltrans at a negative amount. Narratives are truncated to 200 characters.
- Header GL (`gllink_debtors==1`):
  - `(total + FreightCost + TaxTotal) != 0` -> `debtorsact` at `-(total+freight+tax)/CurrencyRate`.
  - `FreightCost != 0` -> `freightact` at `FreightCost/CurrencyRate`.
  - Each `TaxTotals[TaxAuthID] != 0` -> `TaxGLCodes[TaxAuthID]` at `amount/CurrencyRate`.
  - Then `EnsureGLEntriesBalance(11, CreditNo)`, `DB_Txn_Commit()`, unset LineItems and the CreditItems session, and show confirmation with print and re-entry links.

**Z_DeleteCreditNote.php**
- Looks up debtortrans `transno=CreditNoteNo AND type='11'`. Stockmovements are looked up by `type='11'`.
- Inside `DB_Txn_Begin` ... `DB_Txn_Commit`, it deletes in this order: custallocns, debtortranstaxes, debtortrans. It then loops each stockmove and updates `salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced` and `locstock`. Next it deletes salesanalysis, stockmovestaxes, stockserialmoves, stockmoves, and finally gltrans.
- The user is told to repost GL from the credit note's period.

## Order and failure
- `DB_Txn_Begin()` is called in posting. Then come `GetNextTransNo(11)`, `GetPeriod()`, the debtortrans INSERT (id from `DB_Last_Insert_ID`), debtortranstaxes, and the per-line stock, analysis and GL inserts. The header GL entries, `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` and `DB_Txn_Commit` come last. The session is cleared only after commit.
- Every posting `DB_query` carries a "CRITICAL ERROR! NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE: …" message and `true` as the fourth parameter. The meaning of `true` is not shown in the condensation. No custom handler or rollback is shown. Stock and serial inserts use `DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno')` with no check of the value.
- Before posting, the only early exits are the WriteOff-without-GL-code exit and the "already processed" exit.
- `GetPrice`, `GetTaxes`, `GetImageLink` and `glob` have no error handling.
- Z_DeleteCreditNote: every query passes `ErrMsg` and `true`. A failure leaves the uncommitted transaction. No existence check is shown.

## Connections
- `webERP/CreditItemsControlled.php`:
  - Reached by link from controlled lines, with `identifier` and `LineNo`.
  - Guards:
    - Missing `identifier` -> error and exit.
    - Missing `LineNo` (GET or POST) -> error and exit.
    - No session cart `CreditItems<id>` -> error and exit.

The Cart class file was not found by name.
