<?php

/* Credit control functions - shared by order entry, dispatch, the recurring order job, EDI order intake,
 * the API and the credit control pages.
 *
 * Credit status of a customer is the dissallowinvoices flag of the hold reason (holdreasons table) of the customer:
 *   1 = on stop - no new orders, no dispatch/invoice of existing orders unless released by credit control
 *   2 = on watch - orders accepted with a warning and noted for credit control
 *   anything else (0 or the table default -1) = normal
 * Every credit control action is recorded in custcreditevents so the auditors can see the history per customer.
 */

define('CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL', 0);
define('CREDIT_STATUS_STOP', 1);
define('CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH', 2);

/* creditorderholds.status */
define('CREDIT_HOLD_HELD', 0);
define('CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASED', 1);
define('CREDIT_HOLD_NOTED', 2);

/* Transaction types posted by credit control - see systypes */
define('CREDIT_TYPE_INTEREST', 13);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_FEE', 14);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WAIVER', 45);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF', 46);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_RECOVERY', 47);

/* True if the user holds the credit control token */
function CanManageCredit() {
	return (isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']) AND in_array(21, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']));
}

/* True if the user may approve write offs over the approval limit */
function CanApproveWriteOffs() {
	return (isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']) AND in_array(22, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']));
}

function CreditStatusFromFlag($DissallowInvoices) {
	if ($DissallowInvoices == 1) {
		return CREDIT_STATUS_STOP;
	} elseif ($DissallowInvoices == 2) {
		return CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH;
	}
	return CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL;
}

function CreditStatusName($Status) {
	if ($Status == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP) {
		return __('On Stop');
	} elseif ($Status == CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH) {
		return __('Watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

/* Returns the credit position of a customer: status, hold reason, limit, balance, open orders and exposure,
 * all amounts in the customer's currency. Returns false if the customer does not exist */
function GetCustomerCreditPosition($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextreviewdate,
					debtorsmaster.interestexempt,
					debtorsmaster.feeexempt,
					debtorsmaster.paymentterms,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
					currencies.rate,
					currencies.decimalplaces
				FROM debtorsmaster
				INNER JOIN currencies
					ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
				LEFT JOIN holdreasons
					ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
				WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Position = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Position['status'] = CreditStatusFromFlag($Position['dissallowinvoices']);

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance),0) AS balance
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Position['balance'] = $MyRow['balance'];

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(salesorderdetails.unitprice *
									(salesorderdetails.quantity - salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced) *
									(1 - salesorderdetails.discountpercent)),0) AS ordervalue
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN salesorderdetails
							ON salesorders.orderno = salesorderdetails.orderno
						WHERE salesorders.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND salesorderdetails.completed = 0
							AND salesorders.quotation = 0");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Position['openorders'] = $MyRow['ordervalue'];
	$Position['exposure'] = $Position['balance'] + $Position['openorders'];
	$Position['overlimit'] = $Position['exposure'] - $Position['creditlimit'];
	return $Position;
}

function GetCustomerCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
						FROM debtorsmaster
						LEFT JOIN holdreasons
							ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return CreditStatusFromFlag($MyRow['dissallowinvoices']);
}

function CustomerIsOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	return (GetCustomerCreditStatus($DebtorNo) == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP);
}

/* Sales reps (users with a SalesmanLogin) may only see credit information for customers with a branch
 * assigned to them. Customer logins may only see their own account. */
function UserMaySeeCustomerCredit($DebtorNo) {
	global $CustomerLogin;
	if (isset($CustomerLogin) AND $CustomerLogin == 1) {
		return ($DebtorNo == $_SESSION['CustomerID']);
	}
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) AND $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
								AND salesman='" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) . "'");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		return ($MyRow[0] > 0);
	}
	return true;
}

/* Writes an entry to the credit control history of the customer */
function LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, $EventType, $Description, $OldValue = '', $NewValue = '', $Amount = 0, $CurrCode = '', $TransType = 0, $TransNo = 0, $Notes = '') {
	$UserID = isset($_SESSION['UserID']) ? $_SESSION['UserID'] : '';
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO custcreditevents (debtorno,
										eventdate,
										userid,
										eventtype,
										description,
										oldvalue,
										newvalue,
										amount,
										currcode,
										transtype,
										transno,
										notes)
							VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
									NOW(),
									'" . DB_escape_string($UserID) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($EventType) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Description, 0, 255)) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($OldValue, 0, 50)) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($NewValue, 0, 50)) . "',
									'" . floatval($Amount) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
									'" . (int)$TransType . "',
									'" . (int)$TransNo . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Notes) . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history could not be written because'), '', true);
}

function HoldReasonDescription($ReasonCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription, dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . (int)$ReasonCode . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return array('', CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL);
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return array($MyRow['reasondescription'], CreditStatusFromFlag($MyRow['dissallowinvoices']));
}

/* Changes the hold reason (and so the credit status) of a customer and records who, when and why */
function ChangeCustomerCreditStatus($DebtorNo, $NewHoldReason, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT holdreason FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$OldHoldReason = $MyRow['holdreason'];
	if ($OldHoldReason == $NewHoldReason) {
		return false;
	}
	list($OldDescription, $OldStatus) = HoldReasonDescription($OldHoldReason);
	list($NewDescription, $NewStatus) = HoldReasonDescription($NewHoldReason);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . (int)$NewHoldReason . "'
				WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status of the customer could not be updated because'), '', true);
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo,
					'status',
					__('Credit status changed from') . ' ' . CreditStatusName($OldStatus) . ' (' . $OldDescription . ') ' . __('to') . ' ' . CreditStatusName($NewStatus) . ' (' . $NewDescription . ')',
					CreditStatusName($OldStatus) . ' - ' . $OldHoldReason,
					CreditStatusName($NewStatus) . ' - ' . $NewHoldReason,
					0, '', 0, 0, $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Changes the credit limit of a customer and records it */
function ChangeCustomerCreditLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit, currcode FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (abs($MyRow['creditlimit'] - $NewLimit) < 0.005) {
		return false;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . floatval($NewLimit) . "'
				WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit limit of the customer could not be updated because'), '', true);
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo,
					'limit',
					__('Credit limit changed from') . ' ' . $MyRow['creditlimit'] . ' ' . __('to') . ' ' . $NewLimit,
					$MyRow['creditlimit'],
					$NewLimit,
					$NewLimit - $MyRow['creditlimit'],
					$MyRow['currcode'], 0, 0, $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* The date the next credit review is due for a new customer or after a review: today plus the standard review period,
 * or the shorter high risk period for customers on watch */
function DefaultNextReviewDate($Status = CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL) {
	if ($Status == CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH OR $Status == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP) {
		$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditReviewMonthsHighRisk']) ? (int)$_SESSION['CreditReviewMonthsHighRisk'] : 6;
	} else {
		$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths']) ? (int)$_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths'] : 12;
	}
	if ($Months <= 0) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', mktime(0, 0, 0, date('m') + $Months, date('d'), date('Y')));
}

/* The outstanding value of a sales order in the customer's currency (same basis as GetCreditAvailable) */
function SalesOrderOutstandingValue($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(unitprice * (quantity - qtyinvoiced) * (1 - discountpercent)),0)
						FROM salesorderdetails
						WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'
							AND completed=0");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

function GetOrderCreditHold($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT orderno, debtorno, holdtype, status, holddate, ordervalue, exposure, creditlimit,
								releasedby, releasedate, releasedvalue, notes
						FROM creditorderholds
						WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* Called whenever a sales order is created or changed by any route (order entry, web shop customer login, EDI,
 * recurring orders, API). Holds the order for credit approval if it takes the customer over the credit limit,
 * notes orders for customers on watch so credit control can see them, and holds orders for customers on stop.
 * Returns the hold status of the order: CREDIT_HOLD_HELD, CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASED, CREDIT_HOLD_NOTED or false (no hold record) */
function EvaluateOrderCredit($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno, quotation FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$OrderRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($OrderRow['quotation'] == 1) {
		return false;
	}
	$DebtorNo = $OrderRow['debtorno'];
	$Position = GetCustomerCreditPosition($DebtorNo);
	if ($Position === false) {
		return false;
	}
	$OrderValue = SalesOrderOutstandingValue($OrderNo);
	$Tolerance = pow(10, -$Position['decimalplaces']);
	$Hold = GetOrderCreditHold($OrderNo);

	$NewType = '';
	if ($Position['status'] == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP) {
		$NewType = 'stop';
	} elseif ((!isset($_SESSION['CreditHoldOverLimit']) OR $_SESSION['CreditHoldOverLimit'] == 1)
				AND $Position['overlimit'] > $Tolerance) {
		$NewType = 'limit';
	}

	if ($NewType != '') {
		if ($Hold === false) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditorderholds (orderno, debtorno, holdtype, status, holddate, ordervalue, exposure, creditlimit)
					VALUES ('" . (int)$OrderNo . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
							'" . $NewType . "',
							'" . CREDIT_HOLD_HELD . "',
							NOW(),
							'" . $OrderValue . "',
							'" . $Position['exposure'] . "',
							'" . $Position['creditlimit'] . "')";
		} elseif ($Hold['status'] == CREDIT_HOLD_NOTED
				OR ($Hold['status'] == CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASED AND $NewType == 'limit' AND $Hold['holdtype'] != 'stop' AND $OrderValue > $Hold['releasedvalue'] + $Tolerance)) {
			/* a watched order is now over the limit, or a released order has been increased since it was released */
			$SQL = "UPDATE creditorderholds SET holdtype='" . $NewType . "',
												status='" . CREDIT_HOLD_HELD . "',
												holddate=NOW(),
												ordervalue='" . $OrderValue . "',
												exposure='" . $Position['exposure'] . "',
												creditlimit='" . $Position['creditlimit'] . "'
					WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'";
		} elseif ($Hold['status'] == CREDIT_HOLD_HELD) {
			$SQL = "UPDATE creditorderholds SET ordervalue='" . $OrderValue . "',
												exposure='" . $Position['exposure'] . "',
												creditlimit='" . $Position['creditlimit'] . "'
					WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The credit hold of the order could not be updated because'), '', true);
			return CREDIT_HOLD_HELD;
		} else {
			return $Hold['status'];
		}
		DB_query($SQL, __('The order could not be held for credit approval because'), '', true);
		if ($NewType == 'stop') {
			$Description = __('Order') . ' ' . $OrderNo . ' ' . __('held - customer is on stop');
		} else {
			$Description = __('Order') . ' ' . $OrderNo . ' ' . __('held for credit approval - credit limit') . ' ' . locale_number_format($Position['creditlimit'], $Position['decimalplaces']) . ' ' . __('exposure') . ' ' . locale_number_format($Position['exposure'], $Position['decimalplaces']);
		}
		LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'orderhold', $Description, '', $NewType, $OrderValue, $Position['currcode'], 30, $OrderNo);
		return CREDIT_HOLD_HELD;
	}

	if ($Position['status'] == CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH AND $Hold === false) {
		$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditorderholds (orderno, debtorno, holdtype, status, holddate, ordervalue, exposure, creditlimit)
				VALUES ('" . (int)$OrderNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'watch',
						'" . CREDIT_HOLD_NOTED . "',
						NOW(),
						'" . $OrderValue . "',
						'" . $Position['exposure'] . "',
						'" . $Position['creditlimit'] . "')";
		DB_query($SQL, __('The order for a customer on watch could not be recorded because'), '', true);
		LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'watchorder', __('Order') . ' ' . $OrderNo . ' ' . __('taken for a customer on watch'), '', 'watch', $OrderValue, $Position['currcode'], 30, $OrderNo);
		return CREDIT_HOLD_NOTED;
	}
	return ($Hold === false) ? false : $Hold['status'];
}

/* Returns an empty string if the order may be dispatched and invoiced, otherwise the reason it may not */
function OrderCreditBlockReason($OrderNo, $DebtorNo) {
	$Hold = GetOrderCreditHold($OrderNo);
	if ($Hold !== false AND $Hold['status'] == CREDIT_HOLD_HELD) {
		if ($Hold['holdtype'] == 'stop') {
			return __('This order is held because the customer is on stop. It cannot be dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it');
		}
		return __('This order is held for credit approval because it takes the customer over their credit limit. It cannot be dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it');
	}
	if (CustomerIsOnStop($DebtorNo)) {
		if ($Hold !== false AND $Hold['status'] == CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASED AND $Hold['holdtype'] == 'stop') {
			return '';
		}
		return __('The customer is on stop. Goods cannot be dispatched or invoiced on this order unless credit control releases the order');
	}
	return '';
}

/* Credit control releases a held order (or an order of a customer on stop) for dispatch */
function ReleaseOrderCreditHold($OrderNo, $Notes) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$DebtorNo = $MyRow['debtorno'];
	$Position = GetCustomerCreditPosition($DebtorNo);
	$OrderValue = SalesOrderOutstandingValue($OrderNo);
	$Hold = GetOrderCreditHold($OrderNo);
	$HoldType = ($Position['status'] == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP) ? 'stop' : (($Hold === false) ? 'limit' : $Hold['holdtype']);
	if ($Hold === false) {
		$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditorderholds (orderno, debtorno, holdtype, status, holddate, ordervalue, exposure, creditlimit,
											releasedby, releasedate, releasedvalue, notes)
				VALUES ('" . (int)$OrderNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . $HoldType . "',
						'" . CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASED . "',
						NOW(),
						'" . $OrderValue . "',
						'" . $Position['exposure'] . "',
						'" . $Position['creditlimit'] . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						NOW(),
						'" . $OrderValue . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Notes, 0, 255)) . "')";
	} else {
		$SQL = "UPDATE creditorderholds SET holdtype='" . $HoldType . "',
											status='" . CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASED . "',
											releasedby='" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
											releasedate=NOW(),
											releasedvalue='" . $OrderValue . "',
											notes='" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Notes, 0, 255)) . "'
				WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'";
	}
	DB_query($SQL, __('The order could not be released because'), '', true);
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'orderrelease', __('Order') . ' ' . $OrderNo . ' ' . __('released for dispatch by credit control'), $HoldType, 'released', $OrderValue, $Position['currcode'], 30, $OrderNo, $Notes);
	return true;
}

/* The SQL expression for the due date of a debtortrans row - joined to debtorsmaster and paymentterms.
 * Follows the same rule as AgedDebtors.php: days after the transaction date, or a day in the following month */
function DueDateSQL() {
	return "IF(paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0,
				DATE_ADD(debtortrans.trandate, INTERVAL paymentterms.daysbeforedue DAY),
				DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), INTERVAL paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth DAY))";
}

/* Returns the overdue debit items of a customer as at $AsAtDate (SQL format) that are at least $MinDays overdue,
 * excluding items with an open dispute. $ExcludeCharges leaves out interest and fee items (no interest on interest).
 * Also returns the unallocated credits of the customer so that a customer who has paid but whose cash is not yet
 * allocated is not chased or charged. */
function GetOverdueItems($DebtorNo, $AsAtDate, $MinDays, $ExcludeCharges = false) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					systypes.typename,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					debtortrans.balance,
					" . DueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					DATEDIFF('" . $AsAtDate . "', " . DueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
				FROM debtortrans
				INNER JOIN systypes
					ON debtortrans.type=systypes.typeid
				INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
					ON debtortrans.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
				INNER JOIN paymentterms
					ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
				WHERE debtortrans.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
					AND debtortrans.settled=0
					AND debtortrans.balance > 0
					AND debtortrans.trandate <= '" . $AsAtDate . "'
					AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM debtortransdisputes
									WHERE debtortransdisputes.debtortransid=debtortrans.id
										AND debtortransdisputes.resolveddate IS NULL)";
	if ($ExcludeCharges) {
		$SQL .= " AND debtortrans.type NOT IN (" . CREDIT_TYPE_INTEREST . "," . CREDIT_TYPE_FEE . ")";
	}
	$SQL .= " HAVING daysoverdue >= " . (int)$MinDays . "
			ORDER BY debtortrans.trandate, debtortrans.transno";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Items = array();
	$Total = 0;
	$MaxDays = 0;
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
		$Total += $MyRow['balance'];
		if ($MyRow['daysoverdue'] > $MaxDays) {
			$MaxDays = $MyRow['daysoverdue'];
		}
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance),0) FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND settled=0
							AND balance < 0");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return array('items' => $Items,
				'total' => $Total,
				'unallocated' => $MyRow[0],
				'net' => max(0, $Total + $MyRow[0]),
				'maxdays' => $MaxDays);
}

/* Email addresses of the accounts contacts of the customer - contacts flagged to receive statements */
function GetCustomerAccountsEmails($DebtorNo) {
	$Emails = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT email, contactname FROM custcontacts
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND statement=1");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		if (IsEmailAddress($MyRow['email'])) {
			$Emails[$MyRow['email']] = $MyRow['contactname'];
		}
	}
	return $Emails;
}

/* Posts a customer transaction raised by credit control (interest, fee, waiver, write off, recovery):
 * one debtortrans row and, when the debtors ledger is linked to the GL, the debtors control entry against $GLAccount.
 * $Amount is in the customer's currency - positive increases the customer's balance, negative reduces it.
 * Must be called inside a transaction. Returns array(TransNo, DebtorTransID, PeriodNo) */
function PostCreditControlTransaction($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Rate, $TranDate, $Reference, $Narrative, $GLAccount) {
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate($TranDate));

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT custbranch.branchcode, custbranch.salesman, debtorsmaster.salestype
						FROM custbranch INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
							ON custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
						WHERE custbranch.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
						ORDER BY custbranch.disabletrans, custbranch.branchcode
						LIMIT 1");
	$BranchRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									salesperson)
					VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $Type . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($BranchRow['branchcode']) . "',
							'" . $TranDate . "',
							NOW(),
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reference, 0, 50)) . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($BranchRow['salestype']) . "',
							'" . $Rate . "',
							'" . $Amount . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($BranchRow['salesman']) . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer transaction could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	$DebtorTransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1 AND $Amount != 0) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Amount / $Rate, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
		$GLNarrative = DB_escape_string(mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Narrative, 0, 200));
		DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "', '" . $TransNo . "', '" . $TranDate . "', '" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "', '" . $GLNarrative . "', '" . $HomeAmount . "')",
				__('The debtors control GL entry could not be inserted because'), '', true);
		DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "', '" . $TransNo . "', '" . $TranDate . "', '" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($GLAccount) . "', '" . $GLNarrative . "', '" . -$HomeAmount . "')",
				__('The GL entry could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	}
	return array($TransNo, $DebtorTransID, $PeriodNo);
}

/* Allocates $Amount (customer currency, positive) of the credit $FromID to the debit $ToID, in the same way as
 * CustomerAllocations.php: custallocns, alloc/settled/diffonexch on both rows and the realised exchange difference
 * to the GL. Must be called inside a transaction. */
function AllocateCreditControlTransaction($FromID, $ToID, $Amount) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id, type, transno, trandate, rate, alloc, diffonexch,
								(ovamount+ovgst+ovfreight+ovdiscount) AS total
						FROM debtortrans WHERE id IN ('" . (int)$FromID . "','" . (int)$ToID . "')");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		if ($MyRow['id'] == $FromID) {
			$From = $MyRow;
		} else {
			$To = $MyRow;
		}
	}
	$Tolerance = pow(10, -$_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
	/* a positive amount is a gain, negative a loss - same formula as CustomerAllocations.php */
	$DiffOnExch = ($Amount / $From['rate']) - ($Amount / $To['rate']);

	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, '" . $Amount . "', '" . (int)$FromID . "', '" . (int)$ToID . "')",
			__('The allocation record could not be inserted because'), '', true);

	$NewToAlloc = $To['alloc'] + $Amount;
	$ToSettled = (abs($NewToAlloc - $To['total']) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc='" . $NewToAlloc . "',
									diffonexch=diffonexch+" . $DiffOnExch . ",
									settled='" . $ToSettled . "'
				WHERE id='" . (int)$ToID . "'",
			__('The allocated transaction could not be updated because'), '', true);

	$NewFromAlloc = $From['alloc'] - $Amount;
	$FromSettled = (abs($From['total'] - $NewFromAlloc) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc='" . $NewFromAlloc . "',
									diffonexch=diffonexch-" . $DiffOnExch . ",
									settled='" . $FromSettled . "'
				WHERE id='" . (int)$FromID . "'",
			__('The credit transaction could not be updated because'), '', true);

	$HomeDiff = round($DiffOnExch, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
	if ($HomeDiff != 0 AND $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate($From['trandate']));
		DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $From['type'] . "', '" . $From['transno'] . "', '" . $From['trandate'] . "', '" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'] . "', '" . __('Exchange difference') . "', '" . -$HomeDiff . "')",
				__('The exchange difference could not be posted because'), '', true);
		DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $From['type'] . "', '" . $From['transno'] . "', '" . $From['trandate'] . "', '" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "', '" . __('Exchange difference') . "', '" . $HomeDiff . "')",
				__('The exchange difference could not be posted because'), '', true);
	}
	return $DiffOnExch;
}

/* Checks the GL entries of a credit control transaction balance before the commit. Unlike EnsureGLEntriesBalance
 * the caller stops if they do not, so nothing partial is committed. */
function CreditControlGLBalances($Type, $TransNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM gltrans
						WHERE type='" . $Type . "' AND typeno='" . $TransNo . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return (abs($MyRow[0]) < pow(10, -$_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']));
}

/* Posts an approved bad debt write off: a credit of type 46 in the customer's currency at today's rate, debiting the
 * bad debt account, allocated against the written off items (exchange differences are realised through the
 * allocation), and puts the customer on stop if requested. Returns the transaction number or false. */
function PostBadDebtWriteOff($WriteOffID) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditwriteoffs.debtorno, creditwriteoffs.amount, creditwriteoffs.currcode,
								creditwriteoffs.reason, creditwriteoffs.putonstop, creditwriteoffs.status,
								creditwriteoffs.requestedby, creditwriteoffs.approvedby,
								currencies.rate
						FROM creditwriteoffs INNER JOIN currencies
							ON creditwriteoffs.currcode=currencies.currabrev
						WHERE writeoffid='" . (int)$WriteOffID . "'");
	$WriteOff = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($WriteOff['status'] != 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Items = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditwriteoffitems.debtortransid, creditwriteoffitems.amount, debtortrans.balance
						FROM creditwriteoffitems INNER JOIN debtortrans
							ON creditwriteoffitems.debtortransid=debtortrans.id
						WHERE writeoffid='" . (int)$WriteOffID . "'");
	$Tolerance = pow(10, -$_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
	$Total = 0;
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		/* an item may have been part paid since the write off was requested - never write off more than is owed */
		$MyRow['amount'] = min($MyRow['amount'], $MyRow['balance']);
		if ($MyRow['amount'] > $Tolerance) {
			$Items[] = $MyRow;
			$Total += $MyRow['amount'];
		}
	}
	if ($Total <= 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Narrative = __('Bad debt written off') . ' - ' . $WriteOff['reason'];
	list($TransNo, $DebtorTransID, $PeriodNo) = PostCreditControlTransaction($WriteOff['debtorno'],
																		CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF,
																		-$Total,
																		$WriteOff['rate'],
																		date('Y-m-d'),
																		__('Write off') . ' ' . $WriteOffID,
																		$Narrative,
																		$_SESSION['CreditBadDebtAct']);
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		AllocateCreditControlTransaction($DebtorTransID, $Item['debtortransid'], $Item['amount']);
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE creditwriteoffs SET status=1,
										amount='" . $Total . "',
										homeamount='" . round($Total / $WriteOff['rate'], $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']) . "',
										rate='" . $WriteOff['rate'] . "',
										transno='" . $TransNo . "'
				WHERE writeoffid='" . (int)$WriteOffID . "'",
			__('The write off could not be updated because'), '', true);
	LogCreditEvent($WriteOff['debtorno'], 'writeoff', $Narrative, '', '', -$Total, $WriteOff['currcode'], CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF, $TransNo,
					__('Requested by') . ' ' . $WriteOff['requestedby'] . ($WriteOff['approvedby'] != '' ? ', ' . __('approved by') . ' ' . $WriteOff['approvedby'] : ''));
	if ($WriteOff['putonstop'] == 1 AND !CustomerIsOnStop($WriteOff['debtorno'])) {
		ChangeCustomerCreditStatus($WriteOff['debtorno'], $_SESSION['CreditStopHoldReason'], __('Bad debt written off') . ' - ' . __('write off') . ' ' . $WriteOffID);
	}
	return $TransNo;
}

/* Replaces the placeholders in a reminder letter */
function BuildDunningLetter($Text, $Customer, $Overdue) {
	$InvoiceList = '';
	foreach ($Overdue['items'] as $Item) {
		$InvoiceList .= $Item['typename'] . ' ' . $Item['transno'] . '  ' . ConvertSQLDate($Item['trandate']) . '  ' .
						__('due') . ' ' . ConvertSQLDate($Item['duedate']) . '  ' .
						$Customer['currcode'] . ' ' . locale_number_format($Item['balance'], $Customer['decimalplaces']) . '  (' .
						$Item['daysoverdue'] . ' ' . __('days overdue') . ")\n";
	}
	if ($Overdue['unallocated'] < 0) {
		$InvoiceList .= __('Less unallocated payments and credits') . '  ' . $Customer['currcode'] . ' ' . locale_number_format($Overdue['unallocated'], $Customer['decimalplaces']) . "\n";
	}
	$Replace = array('{CustomerName}' => $Customer['name'],
					'{AccountNo}' => $Customer['debtorno'],
					'{Currency}' => $Customer['currcode'],
					'{OverdueAmount}' => locale_number_format($Overdue['net'], $Customer['decimalplaces']),
					'{InvoiceList}' => $InvoiceList,
					'{CompanyName}' => $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['coyname'],
					'{Date}' => date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	return strtr($Text, $Replace);
}

<?php

/* Credit control functions - shared by order entry, dispatch, the recurring order job, EDI order intake,
 * the API and the credit control pages.
 *
 * Credit status of a customer is the dissallowinvoices flag of the hold reason (holdreasons table) of the customer:
 *   1 = on stop - no new orders, no dispatch/invoice of existing orders unless released by credit control
 *   2 = on watch - orders accepted with a warning and noted for credit control
 *   anything else (0 or the table default -1) = normal
 * Every credit control action is recorded in custcreditevents so the auditors can see the history per customer.
 */

define('CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL', 0);
define('CREDIT_STATUS_STOP', 1);
define('CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH', 2);

/* creditorderholds.status */
define('CREDIT_HOLD_HELD', 0);
define('CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASED', 1);
define('CREDIT_HOLD_NOTED', 2);

/* Transaction types posted by credit control - see systypes */
define('CREDIT_TYPE_INTEREST', 13);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_FEE', 14);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WAIVER', 45);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF', 46);
define('CREDIT_TYPE_RECOVERY', 47);

/* True if the user holds the credit control token */
function CanManageCredit() {
	return (isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']) AND in_array(21, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']));
}

/* True if the user may approve write offs over the approval limit */
function CanApproveWriteOffs() {
	return (isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']) AND in_array(22, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']));
}

function CreditStatusFromFlag($DissallowInvoices) {
	if ($DissallowInvoices == 1) {
		return CREDIT_STATUS_STOP;
	} elseif ($DissallowInvoices == 2) {
		return CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH;
	}
	return CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL;
}

function CreditStatusName($Status) {
	if ($Status == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP) {
		return __('On Stop');
	} elseif ($Status == CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH) {
		return __('Watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

/* Returns the credit position of a customer: status, hold reason, limit, balance, open orders and exposure,
 * all amounts in the customer's currency. Returns false if the customer does not exist */
function GetCustomerCreditPosition($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextreviewdate,
					debtorsmaster.interestexempt,
					debtorsmaster.feeexempt,
					debtorsmaster.paymentterms,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
					currencies.rate,
					currencies.decimalplaces
				FROM debtorsmaster
				INNER JOIN currencies
					ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
				LEFT JOIN holdreasons
					ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
				WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Position = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Position['status'] = CreditStatusFromFlag($Position['dissallowinvoices']);

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance),0) AS balance
						FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Position['balance'] = $MyRow['balance'];

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(salesorderdetails.unitprice *
									(salesorderdetails.quantity - salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced) *
									(1 - salesorderdetails.discountpercent)),0) AS ordervalue
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN salesorderdetails
							ON salesorders.orderno = salesorderdetails.orderno
						WHERE salesorders.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND salesorderdetails.completed = 0
							AND salesorders.quotation = 0");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Position['openorders'] = $MyRow['ordervalue'];
	$Position['exposure'] = $Position['balance'] + $Position['openorders'];
	$Position['overlimit'] = $Position['exposure'] - $Position['creditlimit'];
	return $Position;
}

function GetCustomerCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
						FROM debtorsmaster
						LEFT JOIN holdreasons
							ON debtorsmaster.holdreason=holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return CreditStatusFromFlag($MyRow['dissallowinvoices']);
}

function CustomerIsOnStop($DebtorNo) {
	return (GetCustomerCreditStatus($DebtorNo) == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP);
}

/* Sales reps (users with a SalesmanLogin) may only see credit information for customers with a branch
 * assigned to them. Customer logins may only see their own account. */
function UserMaySeeCustomerCredit($DebtorNo) {
	global $CustomerLogin;
	if (isset($CustomerLogin) AND $CustomerLogin == 1) {
		return ($DebtorNo == $_SESSION['CustomerID']);
	}
	if (isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) AND $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
								AND salesman='" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) . "'");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		return ($MyRow[0] > 0);
	}
	return true;
}

/* Writes an entry to the credit control history of the customer */
function LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, $EventType, $Description, $OldValue = '', $NewValue = '', $Amount = 0, $CurrCode = '', $TransType = 0, $TransNo = 0, $Notes = '') {
	$UserID = isset($_SESSION['UserID']) ? $_SESSION['UserID'] : '';
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO custcreditevents (debtorno,
										eventdate,
										userid,
										eventtype,
										description,
										oldvalue,
										newvalue,
										amount,
										currcode,
										transtype,
										transno,
										notes)
							VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
									NOW(),
									'" . DB_escape_string($UserID) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($EventType) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Description, 0, 255)) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($OldValue, 0, 50)) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($NewValue, 0, 50)) . "',
									'" . floatval($Amount) . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "',
									'" . (int)$TransType . "',
									'" . (int)$TransNo . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Notes) . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history could not be written because'), '', true);
}

function HoldReasonDescription($ReasonCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription, dissallowinvoices FROM holdreasons WHERE reasoncode='" . (int)$ReasonCode . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return array('', CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL);
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	return array($MyRow['reasondescription'], CreditStatusFromFlag($MyRow['dissallowinvoices']));
}

/* Changes the hold reason (and so the credit status) of a customer and records who, when and why */
function ChangeCustomerCreditStatus($DebtorNo, $NewHoldReason, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT holdreason FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$OldHoldReason = $MyRow['holdreason'];
	if ($OldHoldReason == $NewHoldReason) {
		return false;
	}
	list($OldDescription, $OldStatus) = HoldReasonDescription($OldHoldReason);
	list($NewDescription, $NewStatus) = HoldReasonDescription($NewHoldReason);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET holdreason='" . (int)$NewHoldReason . "'
				WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit status of the customer could not be updated because'), '', true);
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo,
					'status',
					__('Credit status changed from') . ' ' . CreditStatusName($OldStatus) . ' (' . $OldDescription . ') ' . __('to') . ' ' . CreditStatusName($NewStatus) . ' (' . $NewDescription . ')',
					CreditStatusName($OldStatus) . ' - ' . $OldHoldReason,
					CreditStatusName($NewStatus) . ' - ' . $NewHoldReason,
					0, '', 0, 0, $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* Changes the credit limit of a customer and records it */
function ChangeCustomerCreditLimit($DebtorNo, $NewLimit, $Reason) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit, currcode FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (abs($MyRow['creditlimit'] - $NewLimit) < 0.005) {
		return false;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster SET creditlimit='" . floatval($NewLimit) . "'
				WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'",
			__('The credit limit of the customer could not be updated because'), '', true);
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo,
					'limit',
					__('Credit limit changed from') . ' ' . $MyRow['creditlimit'] . ' ' . __('to') . ' ' . $NewLimit,
					$MyRow['creditlimit'],
					$NewLimit,
					$NewLimit - $MyRow['creditlimit'],
					$MyRow['currcode'], 0, 0, $Reason);
	return true;
}

/* The date the next credit review is due for a new customer or after a review: today plus the standard review period,
 * or the shorter high risk period for customers on watch */
function DefaultNextReviewDate($Status = CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL) {
	if ($Status == CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH OR $Status == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP) {
		$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditReviewMonthsHighRisk']) ? (int)$_SESSION['CreditReviewMonthsHighRisk'] : 6;
	} else {
		$Months = isset($_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths']) ? (int)$_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths'] : 12;
	}
	if ($Months <= 0) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', mktime(0, 0, 0, date('m') + $Months, date('d'), date('Y')));
}

/* The outstanding value of a sales order in the customer's currency (same basis as GetCreditAvailable) */
function SalesOrderOutstandingValue($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(unitprice * (quantity - qtyinvoiced) * (1 - discountpercent)),0)
						FROM salesorderdetails
						WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'
							AND completed=0");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $MyRow[0];
}

function GetOrderCreditHold($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT orderno, debtorno, holdtype, status, holddate, ordervalue, exposure, creditlimit,
								releasedby, releasedate, releasedvalue, notes
						FROM creditorderholds
						WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}

/* Called whenever a sales order is created or changed by any route (order entry, web shop customer login, EDI,
 * recurring orders, API). Holds the order for credit approval if it takes the customer over the credit limit,
 * notes orders for customers on watch so credit control can see them, and holds orders for customers on stop.
 * Returns the hold status of the order: CREDIT_HOLD_HELD, CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASED, CREDIT_HOLD_NOTED or false (no hold record) */
function EvaluateOrderCredit($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno, quotation FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$OrderRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($OrderRow['quotation'] == 1) {
		return false;
	}
	$DebtorNo = $OrderRow['debtorno'];
	$Position = GetCustomerCreditPosition($DebtorNo);
	if ($Position === false) {
		return false;
	}
	$OrderValue = SalesOrderOutstandingValue($OrderNo);
	$Tolerance = pow(10, -$Position['decimalplaces']);
	$Hold = GetOrderCreditHold($OrderNo);

	$NewType = '';
	if ($Position['status'] == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP) {
		$NewType = 'stop';
	} elseif ((!isset($_SESSION['CreditHoldOverLimit']) OR $_SESSION['CreditHoldOverLimit'] == 1)
				AND $Position['overlimit'] > $Tolerance) {
		$NewType = 'limit';
	}

	if ($NewType != '') {
		if ($Hold === false) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditorderholds (orderno, debtorno, holdtype, status, holddate, ordervalue, exposure, creditlimit)
					VALUES ('" . (int)$OrderNo . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
							'" . $NewType . "',
							'" . CREDIT_HOLD_HELD . "',
							NOW(),
							'" . $OrderValue . "',
							'" . $Position['exposure'] . "',
							'" . $Position['creditlimit'] . "')";
		} elseif ($Hold['status'] == CREDIT_HOLD_NOTED
				OR ($Hold['status'] == CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASED AND $NewType == 'limit' AND $Hold['holdtype'] != 'stop' AND $OrderValue > $Hold['releasedvalue'] + $Tolerance)) {
			/* a watched order is now over the limit, or a released order has been increased since it was released */
			$SQL = "UPDATE creditorderholds SET holdtype='" . $NewType . "',
												status='" . CREDIT_HOLD_HELD . "',
												holddate=NOW(),
												ordervalue='" . $OrderValue . "',
												exposure='" . $Position['exposure'] . "',
												creditlimit='" . $Position['creditlimit'] . "'
					WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'";
		} elseif ($Hold['status'] == CREDIT_HOLD_HELD) {
			$SQL = "UPDATE creditorderholds SET ordervalue='" . $OrderValue . "',
												exposure='" . $Position['exposure'] . "',
												creditlimit='" . $Position['creditlimit'] . "'
					WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'";
			DB_query($SQL, __('The credit hold of the order could not be updated because'), '', true);
			return CREDIT_HOLD_HELD;
		} else {
			return $Hold['status'];
		}
		DB_query($SQL, __('The order could not be held for credit approval because'), '', true);
		if ($NewType == 'stop') {
			$Description = __('Order') . ' ' . $OrderNo . ' ' . __('held - customer is on stop');
		} else {
			$Description = __('Order') . ' ' . $OrderNo . ' ' . __('held for credit approval - credit limit') . ' ' . locale_number_format($Position['creditlimit'], $Position['decimalplaces']) . ' ' . __('exposure') . ' ' . locale_number_format($Position['exposure'], $Position['decimalplaces']);
		}
		LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'orderhold', $Description, '', $NewType, $OrderValue, $Position['currcode'], 30, $OrderNo);
		return CREDIT_HOLD_HELD;
	}

	if ($Position['status'] == CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH AND $Hold === false) {
		$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditorderholds (orderno, debtorno, holdtype, status, holddate, ordervalue, exposure, creditlimit)
				VALUES ('" . (int)$OrderNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'watch',
						'" . CREDIT_HOLD_NOTED . "',
						NOW(),
						'" . $OrderValue . "',
						'" . $Position['exposure'] . "',
						'" . $Position['creditlimit'] . "')";
		DB_query($SQL, __('The order for a customer on watch could not be recorded because'), '', true);
		LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'watchorder', __('Order') . ' ' . $OrderNo . ' ' . __('taken for a customer on watch'), '', 'watch', $OrderValue, $Position['currcode'], 30, $OrderNo);
		return CREDIT_HOLD_NOTED;
	}
	return ($Hold === false) ? false : $Hold['status'];
}

/* Returns an empty string if the order may be dispatched and invoiced, otherwise the reason it may not */
function OrderCreditBlockReason($OrderNo, $DebtorNo) {
	$Hold = GetOrderCreditHold($OrderNo);
	if ($Hold !== false AND $Hold['status'] == CREDIT_HOLD_HELD) {
		if ($Hold['holdtype'] == 'stop') {
			return __('This order is held because the customer is on stop. It cannot be dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it');
		}
		return __('This order is held for credit approval because it takes the customer over their credit limit. It cannot be dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it');
	}
	if (CustomerIsOnStop($DebtorNo)) {
		if ($Hold !== false AND $Hold['status'] == CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASED AND $Hold['holdtype'] == 'stop') {
			return '';
		}
		return __('The customer is on stop. Goods cannot be dispatched or invoiced on this order unless credit control releases the order');
	}
	return '';
}

/* Credit control releases a held order (or an order of a customer on stop) for dispatch */
function ReleaseOrderCreditHold($OrderNo, $Notes) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$DebtorNo = $MyRow['debtorno'];
	$Position = GetCustomerCreditPosition($DebtorNo);
	$OrderValue = SalesOrderOutstandingValue($OrderNo);
	$Hold = GetOrderCreditHold($OrderNo);
	$HoldType = ($Position['status'] == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP) ? 'stop' : (($Hold === false) ? 'limit' : $Hold['holdtype']);
	if ($Hold === false) {
		$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditorderholds (orderno, debtorno, holdtype, status, holddate, ordervalue, exposure, creditlimit,
											releasedby, releasedate, releasedvalue, notes)
				VALUES ('" . (int)$OrderNo . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
						'" . $HoldType . "',
						'" . CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASED . "',
						NOW(),
						'" . $OrderValue . "',
						'" . $Position['exposure'] . "',
						'" . $Position['creditlimit'] . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
						NOW(),
						'" . $OrderValue . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Notes, 0, 255)) . "')";
	} else {
		$SQL = "UPDATE creditorderholds SET holdtype='" . $HoldType . "',
											status='" . CREDIT_HOLD_RELEASED . "',
											releasedby='" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['UserID']) . "',
											releasedate=NOW(),
											releasedvalue='" . $OrderValue . "',
											notes='" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Notes, 0, 255)) . "'
				WHERE orderno='" . (int)$OrderNo . "'";
	}
	DB_query($SQL, __('The order could not be released because'), '', true);
	LogCreditEvent($DebtorNo, 'orderrelease', __('Order') . ' ' . $OrderNo . ' ' . __('released for dispatch by credit control'), $HoldType, 'released', $OrderValue, $Position['currcode'], 30, $OrderNo, $Notes);
	return true;
}

/* The SQL expression for the due date of a debtortrans row - joined to debtorsmaster and paymentterms.
 * Follows the same rule as AgedDebtors.php: days after the transaction date, or a day in the following month */
function DueDateSQL() {
	return "IF(paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0,
				DATE_ADD(debtortrans.trandate, INTERVAL paymentterms.daysbeforedue DAY),
				DATE_ADD(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), INTERVAL paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth DAY))";
}

/* Returns the overdue debit items of a customer as at $AsAtDate (SQL format) that are at least $MinDays overdue,
 * excluding items with an open dispute. $ExcludeCharges leaves out interest and fee items (no interest on interest).
 * Also returns the unallocated credits of the customer so that a customer who has paid but whose cash is not yet
 * allocated is not chased or charged. */
function GetOverdueItems($DebtorNo, $AsAtDate, $MinDays, $ExcludeCharges = false) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					systypes.typename,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					debtortrans.balance,
					" . DueDateSQL() . " AS duedate,
					DATEDIFF('" . $AsAtDate . "', " . DueDateSQL() . ") AS daysoverdue
				FROM debtortrans
				INNER JOIN systypes
					ON debtortrans.type=systypes.typeid
				INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
					ON debtortrans.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
				INNER JOIN paymentterms
					ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms=paymentterms.termsindicator
				WHERE debtortrans.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
					AND debtortrans.settled=0
					AND debtortrans.balance > 0
					AND debtortrans.trandate <= '" . $AsAtDate . "'
					AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM debtortransdisputes
									WHERE debtortransdisputes.debtortransid=debtortrans.id
										AND debtortransdisputes.resolveddate IS NULL)";
	if ($ExcludeCharges) {
		$SQL .= " AND debtortrans.type NOT IN (" . CREDIT_TYPE_INTEREST . "," . CREDIT_TYPE_FEE . ")";
	}
	$SQL .= " HAVING daysoverdue >= " . (int)$MinDays . "
			ORDER BY debtortrans.trandate, debtortrans.transno";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Items = array();
	$Total = 0;
	$MaxDays = 0;
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
		$Total += $MyRow['balance'];
		if ($MyRow['daysoverdue'] > $MaxDays) {
			$MaxDays = $MyRow['daysoverdue'];
		}
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance),0) FROM debtortrans
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND settled=0
							AND balance < 0");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return array('items' => $Items,
				'total' => $Total,
				'unallocated' => $MyRow[0],
				'net' => max(0, $Total + $MyRow[0]),
				'maxdays' => $MaxDays);
}

/* Email addresses of the accounts contacts of the customer - contacts flagged to receive statements */
function GetCustomerAccountsEmails($DebtorNo) {
	$Emails = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT email, contactname FROM custcontacts
						WHERE debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND statement=1");

/* Posts a customer transaction raised by credit control (interest, fee, waiver, write off, recovery):
 * one debtortrans row and, when the debtors ledger is linked to the GL, the debtors control entry against $GLAccount.
 * $Amount is in the customer's currency - positive increases the customer's balance, negative reduces it.
 * Must be called inside a transaction. Returns array(TransNo, DebtorTransID, PeriodNo) */
function PostCreditControlTransaction($DebtorNo, $Type, $Amount, $Rate, $TranDate, $Reference, $Narrative, $GLAccount) {
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate($TranDate));

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT custbranch.branchcode, custbranch.salesman, debtorsmaster.salestype
						FROM custbranch INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
							ON custbranch.debtorno=debtorsmaster.debtorno
						WHERE custbranch.debtorno='" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
						ORDER BY custbranch.disabletrans, custbranch.branchcode
						LIMIT 1");
	$BranchRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									salesperson)
					VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
							'" . $Type . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($BranchRow['branchcode']) . "',
							'" . $TranDate . "',
							NOW(),
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string(mb_substr($Reference, 0, 50)) . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($BranchRow['salestype']) . "',
							'" . $Rate . "',
							'" . $Amount . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($BranchRow['salesman']) . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The customer transaction could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	$DebtorTransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1 AND $Amount != 0) {
		$HomeAmount = round($Amount / $Rate, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
		$GLNarrative = DB_escape_string(mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Narrative, 0, 200));
		DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "', '" . $TransNo . "', '" . $TranDate . "', '" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "', '" . $GLNarrative . "', '" . $HomeAmount . "')",
				__('The debtors control GL entry could not be inserted because'), '', true);
		DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "', '" . $TransNo . "', '" . $TranDate . "', '" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($GLAccount) . "', '" . $GLNarrative . "', '" . -$HomeAmount . "')",
				__('The GL entry could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	}
	return array($TransNo, $DebtorTransID, $PeriodNo);
}

/* Allocates $Amount (customer currency, positive) of the credit $FromID to the debit $ToID, in the same way as
 * CustomerAllocations.php: custallocns, alloc/settled/diffonexch on both rows and the realised exchange difference
 * to the GL. Must be called inside a transaction. */
function AllocateCreditControlTransaction($FromID, $ToID, $Amount) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT id, type, transno, trandate, rate, alloc, diffonexch,
								(ovamount+ovgst+ovfreight+ovdiscount) AS total
						FROM debtortrans WHERE id IN ('" . (int)$FromID . "','" . (int)$ToID . "')");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		if ($MyRow['id'] == $FromID) {
			$From = $MyRow;
		} else {
			$To = $MyRow;
		}
	}
	$Tolerance = pow(10, -$_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
	/* a positive amount is a gain, negative a loss - same formula as CustomerAllocations.php */
	$DiffOnExch = ($Amount / $From['rate']) - ($Amount / $To['rate']);

	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, '" . $Amount . "', '" . (int)$FromID . "', '" . (int)$ToID . "')",
			__('The allocation record could not be inserted because'), '', true);

	$NewToAlloc = $To['alloc'] + $Amount;
	$ToSettled = (abs($NewToAlloc - $To['total']) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc='" . $NewToAlloc . "',
									diffonexch=diffonexch+" . $DiffOnExch . ",
									settled='" . $ToSettled . "'
				WHERE id='" . (int)$ToID . "'",
			__('The allocated transaction could not be updated because'), '', true);

	$NewFromAlloc = $From['alloc'] - $Amount;
	$FromSettled = (abs($From['total'] - $NewFromAlloc) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc='" . $NewFromAlloc . "',
									diffonexch=diffonexch-" . $DiffOnExch . ",
									settled='" . $FromSettled . "'
				WHERE id='" . (int)$FromID . "'",
			__('The credit transaction could not be updated because'), '', true);

	$HomeDiff = round($DiffOnExch, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
	if ($HomeDiff != 0 AND $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1) {
		$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(ConvertSQLDate($From['trandate']));
		DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $From['type'] . "', '" . $From['transno'] . "', '" . $From['trandate'] . "', '" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['salesexchangediffact'] . "', '" . __('Exchange difference') . "', '" . -$HomeDiff . "')",
				__('The exchange difference could not be posted because'), '', true);
		DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type, typeno, trandate, periodno, account, narrative, amount)
					VALUES ('" . $From['type'] . "', '" . $From['transno'] . "', '" . $From['trandate'] . "', '" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] . "', '" . __('Exchange difference') . "', '" . $HomeDiff . "')",
				__('The exchange difference could not be posted because'), '', true);
	}
	return $DiffOnExch;
}

/* Checks the GL entries of a credit control transaction balance before the commit. Unlike EnsureGLEntriesBalance
 * the caller stops if they do not, so nothing partial is committed. */
function CreditControlGLBalances($Type, $TransNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM gltrans
						WHERE type='" . $Type . "' AND typeno='" . $TransNo . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return (abs($MyRow[0]) < pow(10, -$_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']));
}

/* Posts an approved bad debt write off: a credit of type 46 in the customer's currency at today's rate, debiting the
 * bad debt account, allocated against the written off items (exchange differences are realised through the
 * allocation), and puts the customer on stop if requested. Returns the transaction number or false. */
function PostBadDebtWriteOff($WriteOffID) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditwriteoffs.debtorno, creditwriteoffs.amount, creditwriteoffs.currcode,
								creditwriteoffs.reason, creditwriteoffs.putonstop, creditwriteoffs.status,
								creditwriteoffs.requestedby, creditwriteoffs.approvedby,
								currencies.rate
						FROM creditwriteoffs INNER JOIN currencies
							ON creditwriteoffs.currcode=currencies.currabrev
						WHERE writeoffid='" . (int)$WriteOffID . "'");
	$WriteOff = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($WriteOff['status'] != 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Items = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditwriteoffitems.debtortransid, creditwriteoffitems.amount, debtortrans.balance
						FROM creditwriteoffitems INNER JOIN debtortrans
							ON creditwriteoffitems.debtortransid=debtortrans.id
						WHERE writeoffid='" . (int)$WriteOffID . "'");
	$Tolerance = pow(10, -$_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']);
	$Total = 0;
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		/* an item may have been part paid since the write off was requested - never write off more than is owed */
		$MyRow['amount'] = min($MyRow['amount'], $MyRow['balance']);
		if ($MyRow['amount'] > $Tolerance) {
			$Items[] = $MyRow;
			$Total += $MyRow['amount'];
		}
	}
	if ($Total <= 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Narrative = __('Bad debt written off') . ' - ' . $WriteOff['reason'];
	list($TransNo, $DebtorTransID, $PeriodNo) = PostCreditControlTransaction($WriteOff['debtorno'],
																		CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF,
																		-$Total,
																		$WriteOff['rate'],
																		date('Y-m-d'),
																		__('Write off') . ' ' . $WriteOffID,
																		$Narrative,
																		$_SESSION['CreditBadDebtAct']);
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		AllocateCreditControlTransaction($DebtorTransID, $Item['debtortransid'], $Item['amount']);
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE creditwriteoffs SET status=1,
										amount='" . $Total . "',
										homeamount='" . round($Total / $WriteOff['rate'], $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces']) . "',
										rate='" . $WriteOff['rate'] . "',
										transno='" . $TransNo . "'
				WHERE writeoffid='" . (int)$WriteOffID . "'",
			__('The write off could not be updated because'), '', true);
	LogCreditEvent($WriteOff['debtorno'], 'writeoff', $Narrative, '', '', -$Total, $WriteOff['currcode'], CREDIT_TYPE_WRITEOFF, $TransNo,
					__('Requested by') . ' ' . $WriteOff['requestedby'] . ($WriteOff['approvedby'] != '' ? ', ' . __('approved by') . ' ' . $WriteOff['approvedby'] : ''));
	if ($WriteOff['putonstop'] == 1 AND !CustomerIsOnStop($WriteOff['debtorno'])) {
		ChangeCustomerCreditStatus($WriteOff['debtorno'], $_SESSION['CreditStopHoldReason'], __('Bad debt written off') . ' - ' . __('write off') . ' ' . $WriteOffID);
	}
	return $TransNo;
}

/* Replaces the placeholders in a reminder letter */
function BuildDunningLetter($Text, $Customer, $Overdue) {
	$InvoiceList = '';
	foreach ($Overdue['items'] as $Item) {
		$InvoiceList .= $Item['typename'] . ' ' . $Item['transno'] . '  ' . ConvertSQLDate($Item['trandate']) . '  ' .
						__('due') . ' ' . ConvertSQLDate($Item['duedate']) . '  ' .
						$Customer['currcode'] . ' ' . locale_number_format($Item['balance'], $Customer['decimalplaces']) . '  (' .
						$Item['daysoverdue'] . ' ' . __('days overdue') . ")\n";
	}
	if ($Overdue['unallocated'] < 0) {
		$InvoiceList .= __('Less unallocated payments and credits') . '  ' . $Customer['currcode'] . ' ' . locale_number_format($Overdue['unallocated'], $Customer['decimalplaces']) . "\n";
	}
	$Replace = array('{CustomerName}' => $Customer['name'],
					'{AccountNo}' => $Customer['debtorno'],
					'{Currency}' => $Customer['currcode'],
					'{OverdueAmount}' => locale_number_format($Overdue['net'], $Customer['decimalplaces']),
					'{InvoiceList}' => $InvoiceList,
					'{CompanyName}' => $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['coyname'],
					'{Date}' => date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	return strtr($Text, $Replace);
}

/**
 * Get weberp authentication, and return a valid database connection, or 1.
 * Note: atm none of the code calling this function does use the returned db connection - it only checks for failure...
 * @return int|resource
 */
function db($user, $password) {

	if (!isset($_SESSION['AccessLevel']) OR $_SESSION['AccessLevel'] == '' OR !isset($_SESSION['db'])) {
		// Login to default database = old clients.
		if ($user != '' AND $password != '') {
			global $api_DatabaseName;
			$rc = LoginAPI($api_DatabaseName, $user, $password);
			if ($rc[0] == UL_OK ) {
				return $_SESSION['db'];
			}
		}
		/// @todo why not return null/false ?
		return NoAuthorisation;
	} else {
		return $_SESSION['db'];
	}
}

// API wrapper for DB issues - no HTML output, AND remember any error message
function api_DB_query( $SQL, $EMsg= '', $DMsg= '', $Transaction='', $TrapErrors=false )
{
    //  Basically we have disabled the error reporting from the standard
    //  query function,  and will remember any error message in the session
    //  data.

    $Result = DB_query($SQL, $EMsg, $DMsg, $Transaction, $TrapErrors);
    if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
        $_SESSION['db_err_msg'] = "SQL: " . $SQL . "\nDB error message: " . DB_error_msg() . "\n";
    } else {
        $_SESSION['db_err_msg'] = '';
    }

}

function InvoiceSalesOrder($OrderNo, $User, $Password) {

	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($User, $Password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$Errors=VerifyOrderHeaderExists($OrderNo, sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (sizeof($Errors)!=0) {
		return $Errors;
	}
	/*Does not deal with assembly items or serialise/lot track items - for use by POS */
	/*Get Company Defaults */
	$ReadCoyResult = api_DB_query("SELECT debtorsact,
											freightact,
											gllink_debtors,
											gllink_stock
									FROM companies
									WHERE coycode=1");

	$CompanyRecord = DB_fetch_array($ReadCoyResult);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoCompanyRecord;
	}

	$OrderHeaderSQL = "SELECT salesorders.debtorno,
							  debtorsmaster.name,
							  salesorders.branchcode,
							  salesorders.customerref,
							  salesorders.orddate,
							  salesorders.ordertype,
							  salesorders.shipvia,
							  custbranch.area,
							  custbranch.taxgroupid,
							  debtorsmaster.currcode,
							  currencies.rate,
							  salesorders.fromstkloc,
							  custbranch.salesman
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
						ON salesorders.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN custbranch
						ON salesorders.debtorno = custbranch.debtorno
						AND salesorders.branchcode = custbranch.branchcode
						INNER JOIN locations
						ON locations.loccode=salesorders.fromstkloc
						INNER JOIN currencies
						ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
						WHERE salesorders.orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'";

	$OrderHeaderResult = api_DB_query($OrderHeaderSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrder;
	}

	$OrderHeader = DB_fetch_array($OrderHeaderResult);

	$TaxProvResult = api_DB_query("SELECT taxprovinceid FROM locations WHERE loccode='" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] ."'");
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoTaxProvince;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($TaxProvResult);
	$DispTaxProvinceID = $MyRow[0];

	$LineItemsSQL = "SELECT stkcode,
							unitprice,
							quantity,
							discountpercent,
							taxcatid,
							mbflag,
							actualcost AS standardcost
					FROM salesorderdetails INNER JOIN stockmaster
					ON salesorderdetails.stkcode = stockmaster.stockid
					WHERE orderno ='" . $OrderNo . "'
					AND completed=0";

	$LineItemsResult = api_DB_query($LineItemsSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0 OR DB_num_rows($LineItemsResult)==0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrderLines;
		return $Errors;
	}

/*Start an SQL transaction */
	DB_Txn_Begin();
/*Now Get the next invoice number - function in SQL_CommonFunctions */
	$InvoiceNo = GetNextTransNo(10);
	$PeriodNo = GetCurrentPeriod();

	$TaxTotals =array();

	$TotalFXNetInvoice = 0;
	$TotalFXTax = 0;
	$LineCounter =0;
	$LineTaxes = array();

	while ($OrderLineRow = DB_fetch_array($LineItemsResult)) {

		$StandardCost = $OrderLineRow['standardcost'];
		$LocalCurrencyPrice= ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'])))/ $OrderHeader['rate'];
		$LineNetAmount = $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent']));

		/*Gets the Taxes and rates applicable to this line from the TaxGroup of the branch and TaxCategory of the item
		and the taxprovince of the dispatch location */

		$SQL = "SELECT taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder,
						taxauthorities.description,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid,
						taxauthorities.taxglcode,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxontax,
						taxauthrates.taxrate
				FROM taxauthrates INNER JOIN taxgrouptaxes ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid
					INNER JOIN taxauthorities ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxauthorities.taxid
				WHERE taxgrouptaxes.taxgroupid='" . $OrderHeader['taxgroupid'] . "'
				AND taxauthrates.dispatchtaxprovince='" . $DispTaxProvinceID . "'
				AND taxauthrates.taxcatid = '" . $OrderLineRow['taxcatid'] . "'
				ORDER BY taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder";

		$GetTaxRatesResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[] = TaxRatesFailed;
		}
		$LineTaxAmount = 0;
		$TaxAuthAmount = 0;
		while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($GetTaxRatesResult)){

			if (!isset($TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'])) {
				$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount']=0;
			}
			$TaxAuthID=$MyRow['taxauthid'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['GLCode'] = $MyRow['taxglcode'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxRate'] = $MyRow['taxrate'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxAuthDescription'] = $MyRow['description'];

			if ($MyRow['taxontax'] ==1){
				$TaxAuthAmount = ($LineNetAmount+$LineTaxAmount) * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			} else {
				$TaxAuthAmount =  $LineNetAmount * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			}
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'] += $TaxAuthAmount;

			/*Make an array of the taxes and amounts including GLcodes for later posting - need debtortransid
			so can only post once the debtor trans is posted - can only post debtor trans when all tax is calculated */
			$LineTaxes[$LineCounter][$MyRow['calculationorder']] = array('TaxCalculationOrder' =>$MyRow['calculationorder'],
											'TaxAuthID' =>$MyRow['taxauthid'],
											'TaxAuthDescription'=>$MyRow['description'],
											'TaxRate'=>$MyRow['taxrate'],
											'TaxOnTax'=>$MyRow['taxontax'],
											'TaxAuthAmount'=>$TaxAuthAmount);
			$LineTaxAmount += $TaxAuthAmount;

		}//end loop around Taxes

		$TotalFXNetInvoice += $LineNetAmount;
		$TotalFXTax += $LineTaxAmount;

		/*Now update SalesOrderDetails for the quantity invoiced and the actual dispatch dates. */
		$SQL = "UPDATE salesorderdetails
				SET qtyinvoiced = qtyinvoiced + " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					actualdispatchdate = '" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] .  "',
					completed='1'
				WHERE orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'
				AND stkcode = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'";

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='B' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='M') {
			$Assembly = false;

			/* Need to get the current location quantity
			will need it later for the stock movement */
			$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
					FROM locstock
					WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);

			if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
				$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
				$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
			} else {
				/* There must be some error this should never happen */
				$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
			}

			$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
					SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "
					WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		} elseif ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A'){ /* its an assembly */
			/*Need to get the BOM for this part and make
			stock moves for the components then update the Location stock balances */
			$Assembly=true;
			$StandardCost =0; /*To start with - accumulate the cost of the comoponents for use in journals later on */
			$SQL = "SELECT bom.component,
							bom.quantity,
							stockmaster.actualcost AS standard
						FROM bom INNER JOIN stockmaster
						ON bom.component=stockmaster.stockid
						WHERE bom.parent='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
						AND bom.effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE
						AND bom.effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE";

			$AssResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

			while ($AssParts = DB_fetch_array($AssResult)){

				$StandardCost += ($AssParts['standard'] * $AssParts['quantity']) ;
				/* Need to get the current location quantity
				will need it later for the stock movement */
				$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
						FROM locstock
						WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";

				$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
				if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
					$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
					$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
				} else {
					/*There must be some error this should never happen */
					$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
				}
				if (empty($AssParts['standard'])) {
					$AssParts['standard']=0;
				}
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
												type,
												transno,
												loccode,
												trandate,
												debtorno,
												branchcode,
												prd,
												reference,
												qty,
												standardcost,
												show_on_inv_crds,
												newqoh)
									VALUES ('" . $AssParts['component'] . "',
											 10,
											 '" . $InvoiceNo . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
											 '" . $DefaultDispatchDate . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
											 '" . $PeriodNo . "',
											 '" . __('Assembly') . ': ' . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . ' ' . __('Order') . ': ' . $OrderNo . "',
											 '" . -$AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
											 '" . $AssParts['standard'] . "',
											 0,
											 '" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "'	)";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

				$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
						SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . ($AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "
						WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromlocstk'] . "'";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /* end of assembly explosion and updates */
		} /* end of its an assembly */


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='D'){
			/*it's a Dummy/Service item or an Assembly item - still need stock movement record
			 * but quantites on hand are always nil */
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'0' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}
		/*Get the ID of the StockMove... */
		$StkMoveNo = DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno');
		/*Insert the taxes that applied to this line */
		foreach ($LineTaxes[$LineCounter] as $Tax) {

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmovestaxes (stkmoveno,
								taxauthid,
								taxrate,
								taxcalculationorder,

function GetCurrentPeriod () {

	$TransDate = time(); //The current date to find the period for
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the last period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);

	if (is_null($MyRow[0])){
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (0,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+1,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (1,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$LastPeriod=1;
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'));
	} else {
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+1,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
	}
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the first period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MIN(lastdate_in_period), MIN(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
	$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1],0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
	$FirstPeriod = $MyRow[1];

	/* If the period number doesn't exist */
	if (!PeriodExists($TransDate)) {
		/* if the transaction is after the last period */
		if ($TransDate > $LastPeriodEnd) {

			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate)+1, 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));

			while ($PeriodEnd >= $LastPeriodEnd) {
				if (Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)<=13) {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)+2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd)+1);
				}
				$LastPeriod++;
				CreatePeriod($LastPeriod, $LastPeriodEnd);
			}
		} else {
		/* The transaction is before the first period */
			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate), 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));
			$Period = $FirstPeriod - 1;
			while ($FirstPeriodEnd > $PeriodEnd) {
				CreatePeriod($Period, $FirstPeriodEnd);
				$Period--;
				if (Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd)>0) {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd), 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,13, 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				}
			}
		}
	} elseif (!PeriodExists(mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate)))) {
		/* Make sure the following months period exists */
		$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+2,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
		CreatePeriod($LastPeriod+1, $LastPeriodEnd);
	}

	/* Now return the period number of the transaction */

	$MonthAfterTransDate = Mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate));
	$GetPrdSQL = "SELECT periodno
					FROM periods
					WHERE lastdate_in_period < '" . Date('Y-m-d', $MonthAfterTransDate) . "'
					AND lastdate_in_period >= '" . Date('Y-m-d', $TransDate) . "'";

	$ErrMsg = __('An error occurred in retrieving the period number');
	$GetPrdResult = DB_query($GetPrdSQL, $ErrMsg);
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($GetPrdResult);

	return $MyRow[0];
}

		$Year=$DateArray[0];
	} elseif ($DateFormat=='d.m.Y') {
		$Day=$DateArray[0];
		$Month=$DateArray[1];
		$Year=$DateArray[2];
	}
	if (!checkdate(intval($Month), intval($Day), intval($Year))) {
		$Errors[$i] = InvalidItemDueDate;
	}
	return $Errors;
}

					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid

		/*Now update SalesOrderDetails for the quantity invoiced and the actual dispatch dates. */
